environmentVariables.name: WONTOPOS_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Wontopos API key (wos-live-...). Create one in the console at wontopos.com.

environmentVariables.name: WONTOPOS_USER_ID
environmentVariables.description: Default store for every tool call (default: "default").

environmentVariables.name: WONTOPOS_MODEL
environmentVariables.description: Engine to read with: tablet-2 (default — same token price as tablet-1, and the one that serves photos and re-ask), tablet-1, scroll-1, or scroll-1.2.

environmentVariables.name: WONTOPOS_VERIFY
environmentVariables.description: Default re-ask passes for search, 0-3 (default 0). Each pass is another engine call and is billed for what it delivers; the agent can raise it per call.

environmentVariables.name: WONTOPOS_MAX_IMAGES
environmentVariables.description: Default photo results per search, 0-5 (default 0). Zero because these rows ride on every search; the view_image tool fetches the one picture that is wanted.

environmentVariables.name: WONTOPOS_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: A different API host. Leave unset for the default.

environmentVariables.name: WONTOPOS_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: Per-request timeout in ms (default 20000). A stalled API then fails in-band instead of hanging the host.

environmentVariables.name: WONTOPOS_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 for read-only mode: recall/search/list_memories/engram/stats/revisions/view_image/usage only, no write or delete tools.

environmentVariables.name: WONTOPOS_ALLOW_STORE_OVERRIDE
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to let tools take a user_id argument (multi-store). Default: every call is pinned to WONTOPOS_USER_ID.

environmentVariables.name: WONTOPOS_HTTP_PORT
environmentVariables.description: Serve over HTTP on this port instead of stdio, for hosts that cannot spawn a local process. Requires WONTOPOS_HTTP_TOKEN.

environmentVariables.name: WONTOPOS_HTTP_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Bearer token every HTTP request must carry. Required whenever WONTOPOS_HTTP_PORT is set.

environmentVariables.name: WONTOPOS_HTTP_HOST
environmentVariables.description: Interface to bind in HTTP mode. Default 127.0.0.1 (this machine only).

environmentVariables.name: WONTOPOS_HTTP_ALLOWED_HOSTS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated Host header values to accept in HTTP mode, for a tunnel that forwards its own public name. Loopback and the bind address are always accepted; anything else is refused 403.

environmentVariables.name: DATABASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Your own PostgreSQL, where this library keeps file ownership, grants and the audit chain. Apply node_modules/@filelayer/core/schema.sql once before starting.

environmentVariables.name: FILELAYER_AS
environmentVariables.description: The ONE subject this server speaks for, in your own id space. Fixed for the life of the process: no tool reads it as an argument and no tool can change it, which is the only reason exposing these tools to an agent is safe. Write it yourself or have your provisioning write it, never derive it from a conversation. Serving several people means starting several servers.

environmentVariables.name: FILELAYER_ORG
environmentVariables.description: The organisation this server is scoped to, in your own id space.

environmentVariables.name: FILELAYER_DATA_DIR
environmentVariables.description: A local directory for the bytes. Needs no bucket and no IAM user. Set this OR the S3_* block: with neither, the server refuses to start rather than falling back to memory, which would work in a demo and lose the first real file.

environmentVariables.name: S3_ENDPOINT
environmentVariables.description: An S3-compatible endpoint, for example https://<account>.r2.cloudflarestorage.com. Setting it makes S3_BUCKET, S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID and S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY required.

environmentVariables.name: S3_BUCKET
environmentVariables.description: The bucket. It must be private: this library decides who may be GIVEN a URL and has no say in who the object store will answer. `npx -p @filelayer/core filelayer doctor` reports whether yours serves unauthenticated reads.

environmentVariables.name: S3_REGION
environmentVariables.description: Region, or `auto` for Cloudflare R2.

environmentVariables.name: S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID
environmentVariables.description: Access key id for the bucket.

environmentVariables.name: S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Secret access key for the bucket.

environmentVariables.name: FILELAYER_MCP_AGENT_LABEL
environmentVariables.description: How this agent names itself in the audit trail, recorded on every event these tools produce. It is what lets the chain separate "the partner opened this document" from "the partner's assistant opened this document".

environmentVariables.name: FILELAYER_MCP_ALLOW_DESTRUCTIVE
environmentVariables.description: Set to exactly `true` to register delete_file. Off by default because deleting is not recoverable and an agent that misreads a sentence deletes the wrong thing silently.

environmentVariables.name: FILELAYER_MCP_EXPOSE_AUDIT
environmentVariables.description: Set to exactly `true` to register file_audit. Off by default because the trail is an organisation's whole history and a tool that returns it copies every file name, actor and denial into the model's context. Reading it is itself audited since 0.27.0, which was the previous reason; the default did not move.

environmentVariables.name: FILELAYER_MCP_RETURN_BYTES
environmentVariables.description: Set to exactly `true` to register read_file. Off by default because a document returned by a tool is a document copied into a model's context; file_info plus a share link is usually what was actually needed.

environmentVariables.name: FILELAYER_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: The base of the share URLs this instance mints. Without it, share links come back without a URL.

servers.name: io.form/formio-mcp
servers.description: Create and manage Form.io forms, resources, actions, roles, and projects from your AI agent.

environmentVariables.name: FORMIO_PROJECT_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional, and the WEAKEST of the three project sources: a committed formio.json found by walking up from the working directory wins, then the per-directory mapping project_set writes, then this. It pins nothing — project_set can redirect a directory whose environment names a different project. Useful for a launch with nowhere to record a project, such as CI or a container (e.g. https://examples.form.io on the hosted cloud; self-hosted it is either https://your-project.your-domain.com or https://your-host/project-name, depending on how that deployment routes projects). Leave it unset and the agent asks for a project and records it per directory.

environmentVariables.name: FORMIO_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional, and usually unnecessary: the base URL is DERIVED from the project URL — https://api.form.io for a project on a form.io host, the parent path for a project addressed as a sub-directory — and is asked for only when it cannot be derived, which is a path-less project URL on a customer domain. There is no default. Like FORMIO_PROJECT_URL it is the weakest source, behind a committed formio.json and the per-directory mapping.

environmentVariables.name: FORMIO_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Form.io project API key. Optional — applied only to the project FORMIO_PROJECT_URL names, so set FORMIO_PROJECT_URL beside it; any other project, and every project when it is omitted, uses the browser-based portal login flow to obtain a JWT.

environmentVariables.name: FORMIO_LOGIN_FORM
environmentVariables.description: URL of a custom login form used by the browser-based portal login flow. Defaults to the deployment's portal login form.

environmentVariables.name: FORMIO_AUTH_HOST
environmentVariables.description: Address the browser-login page binds to. Optional; defaults to 127.0.0.1. Set it to 0.0.0.0, together with FORMIO_AUTH_PORT, when the server runs in a container or on a remote machine and the login page must be reachable through a published port. 0.0.0.0 exposes the page on every interface for the duration of a login.

environmentVariables.name: FORMIO_AUTH_PORT
environmentVariables.description: Fixed port for the browser-login page, so a container can publish it (e.g. 43117). Optional; a positive integer, and by default the page takes an ephemeral port.

environmentVariables.name: FORMIO_AUTH_TIMEOUT
environmentVariables.description: Seconds to wait for a browser login before the call fails with an error naming the remedies. Optional; a positive integer no larger than 2147483, and any other value is ignored. Defaults to 900.

environmentVariables.name: FORMIO_FORCE_BROWSER
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to attempt the browser login even where the server detects it cannot present one (CI, a container, a remote shell with no display). Use it when the login page is reachable from a browser elsewhere.

environmentVariables.name: FORMIO_REQUEST_TIMEOUT
environmentVariables.description: Seconds a Form.io request may go unanswered before the call fails with a network error naming the URL. Optional; a positive integer no larger than 2147483, and any other value is ignored. Defaults to 60. project_import and project_export wait 300 seconds, or this value when it is longer.

environmentVariables.name: FORMIO_INSECURE_TLS
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to skip TLS certificate verification only for requests to the configured deployment (the hosts of the resolved project URL and base URL); every other host is verified as usual. For local development against self-signed certificates only — never enable in production.

environmentVariables.name: A2UI5_MCP_WORKSPACE
environmentVariables.description: Where the npm backend installs, the dev sandbox lives and a framework clone lands. Default: ~/.abap2ui5-mcp.

environmentVariables.name: A2UI5_MCP_BACKEND
environmentVariables.description: Which backend runs the apps: npm (the @abap2ui5/node-runtime package, even beside a checkout) or clone (clone the framework). Default: decided per call.

environmentVariables.name: A2UI5_MCP_RUNTIME_VERSION
environmentVariables.description: Pin the @abap2ui5/node-runtime release (X.Y.Z) the npm backend installs. Default: the registry's latest.

environmentVariables.name: A2UI5_MCP_PORT
environmentVariables.description: Port of the local backend run_app boots against. Default: 3000.

environmentVariables.name: A2UI5_MCP_UI
environmentVariables.description: Whether app_start/app_describe/app_act declare their MCP Apps screen (ui://abap2ui5/app-screen): auto (default - when the client advertises the io.modelcontextprotocol/ui extension), on, off.

environmentVariables.name: A2UI5_MCP_APP_FORMAT
environmentVariables.description: The default answer format of the app tools: snapshot (default) or adaptive-card (the snapshot plus an Adaptive Card 1.5 as an embedded resource, for card-rendering hosts).

environmentVariables.name: A2UI5_MCP_OFFLINE
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 for no network: no UI5 CDN fallback, no GitHub mirror, no registry lookup.

environmentVariables.name: A2UI5_MCP_REMOTE
environmentVariables.description: Set to 0 to switch off the read-only GitHub mirror used when no checkout is found.

environmentVariables.name: A2UI5_MCP_REMOTE_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Cache directory of the GitHub mirror. Default: <tmp>/abap2ui5-mcp-remote.

environmentVariables.name: A2UI5_MCP_REMOTE_TTL_MS
environmentVariables.description: How long a mirrored copy is used before it is refreshed, in milliseconds. Default: one day.

environmentVariables.name: A2UI5_MCP_UI5_CACHE_MB
environmentVariables.description: How many MB of UI5 answers from the CDN (sdk.openui5.org) run_app and interact_app keep in memory across calls, so a second boot does not download them again. 0 switches the cache off. Default: 64.

environmentVariables.name: A2UI5_MCP_RENDER_PAGES
environmentVariables.description: Pages (Chromium tabs) of validate_view's warm render gate, which concurrent calls queue on. Default: 2 (1 to 8).

environmentVariables.name: A2UI5_MCP_CHROMIUM
environmentVariables.description: Chromium binary for run_app and interact_app. Default: CHROMIUM_BIN, Playwright's managed browser, then a system chromium.

environmentVariables.name: A2UI5_MCP_SCREENSHOT_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Where run_app and interact_app write their PNGs (the newest 50 are kept) and build_backend its log. Default: <tmp>/abap2ui5-mcp-screenshots.

environmentVariables.name: A2UI5_MCP_PREBUILT_URL
environmentVariables.description: Where build_backend mode prebuilt downloads the backend from. Default: the framework's release asset.

environmentVariables.name: A2UI5_MCP_LINT_WORKER
environmentVariables.description: Set to 0 to run every lint as a fresh abaplint process. Default: a long-lived worker keeps @abaplint/core with the framework parsed and lints a deploy in milliseconds (the CLI runs whenever the worker cannot stand in for it).

environmentVariables.name: A2UI5_MCP_LINT_IDLE_MS
environmentVariables.description: How long the warm lint worker (about 300 MB with the framework parsed) is kept without a request before it exits, in milliseconds; the next lint starts a fresh one. 0 keeps it for the server's life. Default: 10 minutes.

environmentVariables.name: A2UI5_MCP_LINT_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: Hard timeout of the abaplint run, in milliseconds. Default: 5 minutes.

environmentVariables.name: A2UI5_MCP_SCOPE_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: Hard timeout of scope_of, in milliseconds. Default: 5 minutes.

environmentVariables.name: A2UI5_MCP_BUILD_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: Hard timeout of a build, the prebuilt download and the npm install, in milliseconds. Default: 30 minutes.

environmentVariables.name: A2UI5_MCP_UNIT_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: Hard timeout of the ABAP Unit runner, in milliseconds. Default: 10 minutes.

environmentVariables.name: A2UI5_MCP_SYSTEM_URL
environmentVariables.description: Switches on the SYSTEM MODE: the app tools against this real SAP system instead of the sandbox loop. The launch URL, e.g. https://host:44300/sap/bc/z2ui5?app_start={class}&sap-client=100.

environmentVariables.name: A2UI5_MCP_SYSTEM_USER
environmentVariables.description: System mode: the SAP user the app tools log on with (Basic authentication).

environmentVariables.name: A2UI5_MCP_SYSTEM_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: System mode: the password of A2UI5_MCP_SYSTEM_USER. Or A2UI5_MCP_SYSTEM_PASSWORD_CMD, to keep it out of the configuration.

environmentVariables.name: A2UI5_MCP_SYSTEM_PASSWORD_CMD
environmentVariables.description: System mode: a shell command that prints the password (a keychain lookup) - instead of A2UI5_MCP_SYSTEM_PASSWORD.

environmentVariables.name: A2UI5_MCP_SYSTEM_INSECURE_TLS
environmentVariables.description: System mode: set to 1 to accept a certificate that cannot be verified. NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS with the CA is the better fix.

environmentVariables.name: GITHUB_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Optional token sent to api.github.com only, to raise the rate limit of the docs tree listing (GH_TOKEN is read too).

servers.name: io.github.antonorlov/mcp-postgres-server
servers.title: PostgreSQL
servers.description: MCP server for PostgreSQL: local, Docker, RDS, Neon, Supabase, or behind an SSH bastion.

environmentVariables.name: DATABASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Full connection string (preferred). Supports sslmode in the URL.

environmentVariables.name: PG_HOST
environmentVariables.description: Database host (fallback when DATABASE_URL is not set).

environmentVariables.name: PG_PORT
environmentVariables.description: Database port.

environmentVariables.name: PG_USER
environmentVariables.description: Database user.

environmentVariables.name: PG_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: Database password.

environmentVariables.name: PG_DATABASE
environmentVariables.description: Database name.

environmentVariables.name: PG_ALLOW_WRITE
environmentVariables.description: When true, execute performs writes and reads are sent directly. Off (default) is read-only: execute refuses writes and each read runs in a READ ONLY transaction.

environmentVariables.name: PG_SSLMODE
environmentVariables.description: TLS mode. require/allow/prefer encrypt without verifying the certificate; verify-ca/verify-full verify it (supply a CA via PG_SSL_CA). Unlike libpq, allow/prefer do not fall back to plaintext, so a server without TLS needs disable.

environmentVariables.name: PG_SSL_CA
environmentVariables.description: Path to a CA certificate file. Setting it by itself implies verify-full.

environmentVariables.name: PG_ENABLE_RUNTIME_CONNECT
environmentVariables.description: Register the connect_db tool (runtime credential switching).

environmentVariables.name: PG_MAX_RESULT_BYTES
environmentVariables.description: Byte budget for a query result sent to the model. Whole rows are kept while they fit; over the budget returnedRows < rowCount and truncated is true.

environmentVariables.name: PG_STATEMENT_TIMEOUT
environmentVariables.description: Statement timeout in milliseconds, applied to every session.

environmentVariables.name: PG_CONNECT_TIMEOUT
environmentVariables.description: Timeout in milliseconds for a single connect attempt (raise it for slow links or SSH tunnels).

environmentVariables.name: PG_SSH_HOST
environmentVariables.description: SSH bastion host. Setting it enables tunneling: the server reaches the database only through an SSH tunnel to this host. Needs the ssh2 optional dependency.

environmentVariables.name: PG_SSH_PORT
environmentVariables.description: SSH bastion port.

environmentVariables.name: PG_SSH_USER
environmentVariables.description: SSH username.

environmentVariables.name: PG_SSH_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Path to a private key file. If unset, auth falls back like ssh: a running agent (SSH_AUTH_SOCK), then a default key (~/.ssh/id_ed25519, id_rsa, id_ecdsa).

environmentVariables.name: PG_SSH_PASSPHRASE
environmentVariables.description: Passphrase for the private key, if encrypted.

environmentVariables.name: PG_SSH_AGENT
environmentVariables.description: true to use the ambient agent (SSH_AUTH_SOCK), or an explicit socket path / Windows named pipe.

environmentVariables.name: PG_SSH_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: SSH login password. Opt-in; a key or agent takes precedence. Prefer keys, a bastion often disables password auth.

environmentVariables.name: PG_SSH_FINGERPRINT
environmentVariables.description: Pinned host-key fingerprint (SHA256:...). Host-key verification is mandatory and set only this way: without it the tunnel refuses to connect. Get it with ssh-keygen -lF host.

environmentVariables.name: PG_SSH_KEEPALIVE_INTERVAL
environmentVariables.description: SSH keepalive interval in ms; the tunnel drops after 3 unanswered keepalives, and the next call reconnects.

Set in your MCP client's configuration, the seed sits inside the governed client's trust domain. Receipts are kept in memory only; save a generate_evidence_bundle result before the server stops. environmentVariables.name: AGA_GATEWAY_KEY_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Path to a file holding the 64-hex Ed25519 seed; read only when AGA_GATEWAY_KEY is unset or empty, with the same effect. A stdio server started by your MCP client runs as the client's OS user, so the file sits inside the governed client's trust domain. Missing, unreadable or invalid: a new key each start, warned on stderr.

environmentVariables.name: APPLE_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Contents of that key's .p8 file (PEM; one-line values with \n escapes and base64 are accepted).

environmentVariables.name: APPLE_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Local installs only: a path to the .p8 file instead of APPLE_PRIVATE_KEY.

environmentVariables.name: APPLE_MUSIC_KEY_ID
environmentVariables.description: Optional per-service override of APPLE_KEY_ID for Apple Music (pair with APPLE_MUSIC_PRIVATE_KEY).

environmentVariables.name: APPLE_MUSIC_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional per-service override of APPLE_PRIVATE_KEY for Apple Music.

environmentVariables.name: APPLE_MAPS_KEY_ID
environmentVariables.description: Optional per-service override of APPLE_KEY_ID for Apple Maps.

environmentVariables.name: APPLE_MAPS_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional per-service override of APPLE_PRIVATE_KEY for Apple Maps.

environmentVariables.name: APPLE_WEATHERKIT_KEY_ID
environmentVariables.description: Optional per-service override of APPLE_KEY_ID for WeatherKit.

environmentVariables.name: APPLE_WEATHERKIT_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional per-service override of APPLE_PRIVATE_KEY for WeatherKit.

environmentVariables.name: APPLE_WEATHERKIT_SERVICE_ID
environmentVariables.description: WeatherKit only: the Services ID registered for WeatherKit (e.g. com.example.weather).

environmentVariables.name: APPLE_MUSIC_DEVELOPER_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Optional: a pre-minted Apple Music developer token (JWT) instead of signing one from the key above.

environmentVariables.name: APPLE_MUSIC_USER_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Music User Token for your library (official API), from a one-time MusicKit sign-in: `npx apple-icloud-mcp music-auth`. Without the Apple Developer key, ask the owner for a developer token (music-auth --print-developer-token) and run it with APPLE_MUSIC_DEVELOPER_TOKEN set. Lasts ~6 months.

environmentVariables.name: APPLE_MUSIC_WEB_USER_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Opt-in web-player mode (no developer account needed; unlocks rename/delete/remove/reorder): the media-user-token cookie from a signed-in music.apple.com tab.

environmentVariables.name: APPLE_MUSIC_WEB_DEVELOPER_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Optional override for the web-player developer token (normally read automatically from music.apple.com).

environmentVariables.name: APPLE_MUSIC_STOREFRONT
environmentVariables.description: Two-letter Apple Music storefront (e.g. us, gb). Default: your account's storefront, else us.

environmentVariables.name: ICLOUD_USERNAME
environmentVariables.description: Your Apple ID email, for iCloud Calendar, Contacts and Mail.

environmentVariables.name: ICLOUD_APP_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: An app-specific password from appleid.apple.com → Sign-In and Security → App-Specific Passwords (NOT your Apple ID password).

environmentVariables.name: ICLOUD_MAIL_ADDRESS
environmentVariables.description: Your @icloud.com address, only if your Apple ID email is not an iCloud address (needed for Mail).

environmentVariables.name: ICLOUD_DEFAULT_CALENDAR
environmentVariables.description: Calendar new events go to when none is named (default: the first writable event calendar).

environmentVariables.name: APPLE_WRITE_MODE
environmentVariables.description: "none" = read-only tools; "additive" = also create/append, never modify, delete or send; "all" = everything (default). Unrecognized values fail closed to "none".

environmentVariables.name: APPLE_SERVICES
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated services to enable (music, calendar, contacts, mail, maps, weather, itunes). Default: all.

environmentVariables.name: DISPLAY_TZ
environmentVariables.description: IANA time zone (e.g. America/New_York) for displayed times and for dates you give without an offset. Set this on a hosted server, which runs in UTC.

environmentVariables.name: APPLE_UNITS
environmentVariables.description: "metric" (default) or "imperial" units for weather (Maps distances always show both).

environmentVariables.name: APPLE_STATE_CACHE
environmentVariables.description: Set to false to write nothing under $MCP_DATA_DIR/.apple-icloud-mcp: no web-player token or iCloud discovery cache, and the rejected-password latch and spent confirmation tokens then last only as long as the process.

environmentVariables.name: APPLE_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: Per-request timeout in milliseconds (default 30000).

environmentVariables.name: APPLE_DEBUG_LOG
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to log every upstream request line to stderr (credentials redacted).

environmentVariables.name: MCP_CONFIRM_MODE
environmentVariables.description: How confirm-gated writes (send mail, deletes, removing tracks, invitations) behave on a client with no prompt, like claude.ai: "ask-user" (default: preview + confirmToken, the model must get your OK), "auto", or "refuse". Unknown values mean refuse.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_CONFIRM_ELICITATION
environmentVariables.description: "off" never shows a confirmation prompt, so every client gets the MCP_CONFIRM_MODE flow. Set it for a client that says it can prompt but never does (the gated call hangs, e.g. opencode 2.0.x). Any other value stays "on" (with a stderr warning).

environmentVariables.name: MCP_CONFIRM_TTL_SECONDS
environmentVariables.description: Lifetime of a confirmToken in seconds (default 600).

environmentVariables.name: MCP_CONFIRM_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Signing key for confirmTokens. Random per process by default; set it so a token issued just before a restart or redeploy still works (spent tokens are recorded on disk, so none can be replayed).

servers.name: io.github.chrischall/ofw-mcp
servers.description: OurFamilyWizard co-parenting for Claude — messages, calendar, expenses, and journal

environmentVariables.name: OFW_USERNAME
environmentVariables.description: Your OurFamilyWizard login email address. Optional — if omitted, the server falls back to the fetchproxy browser extension (requires being signed in to ourfamilywizard.com).

environmentVariables.name: OFW_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: Your OurFamilyWizard password. Optional — see OFW_USERNAME.

environmentVariables.name: OFW_WRITE_MODE
environmentVariables.description: Write-tool gate: "none" registers no write tools; "drafts" registers draft-level writes only (save/delete drafts, upload attachments); "all" registers everything (default). Unrecognized values fail closed to "none".

environmentVariables.name: OFW_CALENDAR_WRITES
environmentVariables.description: Set to "true" to register calendar write tools (create/update/delete event) in "drafts" write mode. Events have no draft stage but are reversible. Never overrides "none".

environmentVariables.name: OFW_ALLOW_MARK_READ
environmentVariables.description: Default "true". Set "false" to forbid any tool from marking a message read on OurFamilyWizard - reading a body for the first time stamps a co-parent-visible "First Viewed" time that cannot be undone. A ceiling: no per-call argument can raise it.

environmentVariables.name: OFW_FETCH_UNREAD_BODIES
environmentVariables.description: Default "false". Whether ofw_sync_messages fetches unread inbox bodies by default (each fetch stamps a First Viewed time). Capped by OFW_ALLOW_MARK_READ.

environmentVariables.name: OFW_SESSION_CACHE
environmentVariables.description: Set to false to disable the on-disk session cache and re-authenticate on every process start. Defaults to enabled.

environmentVariables.name: OFW_SESSION_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Absolute path for the session cache file. Defaults to $MCP_DATA_DIR/.ofw-mcp/session.json.

environmentVariables.name: OFW_EXPENSE_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Set true to register only healthcheck plus expense tools. All profile/dashboard, message, calendar, and journal tools are structurally absent.

environmentVariables.name: OFW_EXPENSE_UPLOAD_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Set true for strict reimbursement upload mode: only healthcheck, ofw_upload_expense_pdf, ofw_create_expense, and ofw_update_expense register. Implies OFW_EXPENSE_ONLY.

environmentVariables.name: OFW_INLINE_ATTACHMENTS
environmentVariables.description: Set "true" to return attachments as MCP content blocks by default (images render directly; other files come back as embedded resources) instead of writing to disk. Callers can still override per call via the tool's `inline` argument.

environmentVariables.name: OFW_ATTACHMENTS_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Where ofw_download_attachment writes (default ~/Downloads/ofw-mcp). Every disk write is confined to it: a saveTo outside it (after resolving symlinks) is refused, and an existing file is replaced only with force:true.

environmentVariables.name: OFW_UPLOAD_DIR
environmentVariables.description: The only directory ofw_upload_attachment may read from (default: OFW_ATTACHMENTS_DIR). Paths outside it after resolving symlinks, hidden files/dirs, and files over 25 MiB are refused.

environmentVariables.name: OFW_CACHE_IDENTITY
environmentVariables.description: Explicit cache-key label; overrides OFW_USERNAME for fetchproxy-only multi-account setups. If you have multiple OFW accounts and want them to use separate caches, set it to a label per profile.

environmentVariables.name: OFW_CACHE_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Overrides the message cache directory (default ~/.cache/ofw-mcp).

environmentVariables.name: OFW_DISABLE_FETCHPROXY
environmentVariables.description: Skip the fetchproxy fallback, so missing credentials become a hard error (useful in headless CI).

environmentVariables.name: OFW_AUTO_REFRESH
environmentVariables.description: When a cached read comes back EMPTY from a non-fresh cache, the read tools sync the backing folders and answer from the refreshed cache instead of refusing with UNVERIFIED_EMPTY (default off, i.e. refuse). Per-call autoRefresh overrides it. A refresh that does not make the read verifiable still refuses.

environmentVariables.name: OFW_FRESHNESS_TTL_SECONDS
environmentVariables.description: How long a verified-against-OFW folder stays labelled `fresh` in read tools' `freshness` block (default 300). Unusable values fall back to the default — a typo must never widen the window in which stale data reads as current.

environmentVariables.name: OFW_SYNC_MAX_REQUESTS
environmentVariables.description: Per-call OFW-request budget for ofw_sync_messages: a positive integer caps how many OFW requests one sync call may make before pausing; the next call resumes where it left off. Unset means unbounded (local installs walk fully in one call).

environmentVariables.name: OFW_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: Per-request timeout for OFW API calls, in milliseconds (default 30000). Each retry gets its own fresh window.

environmentVariables.name: OFW_DEBUG_LOG
environmentVariables.description: Log every OFW request/response to stderr (Authorization redacted). Diagnostic only.

environmentVariables.name: DISPLAY_TZ
environmentVariables.description: IANA zone (e.g. America/New_York, the default) for every `<field>Display` value, and the zone a NAIVE source timestamp is assumed to be wall-clock in. OFW's API reports naive local times in the account's own zone, so this must match it. Unrecognized values fall back to the default.

environmentVariables.name: FETCHPROXY_WS_PORT
environmentVariables.description: Localhost port of the fetchproxy concentrator the ContextMint Bridge extension connects to (default 37149). Every MCP on one machine shares it, so move it for all of them or not at all.

environmentVariables.name: FETCHPROXY_WS_HOST
environmentVariables.description: Bind interface for the fetchproxy concentrator, a literal IP only (default 127.0.0.1). Keep on loopback; it exists for hosted deployments that run each MCP in its own network namespace.

environmentVariables.name: FETCHPROXY_IDENTITY_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Absolute path where the fetchproxy long-term identity keypair is stored (default ~/.fetchproxy/identity/).

servers.description: MCP server for controlling HomeMatic smart home devices via the CCU JSON-RPC API

environmentVariables.name: CCU_HOST
environmentVariables.description: Hostname or IP of your HomeMatic CCU (debmatic, CCU3, or OpenCCU/RaspberryMatic)

environmentVariables.name: CCU_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: CCU admin password (same as the WebUI login). Must be set; the value may be empty for a CCU with no password

environmentVariables.name: CCU_USER
environmentVariables.description: CCU username

environmentVariables.name: CCU_HTTPS
environmentVariables.description: Connect to the CCU via HTTPS (self-signed certificates supported)

environmentVariables.name: CCU_PORT
environmentVariables.description: CCU API port (80 for HTTP, 443 for HTTPS)

environmentVariables.name: CACHE_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Directory for the device type cache and session persistence

environmentVariables.name: MCP_ALLOWED_ORIGINS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated allowlist of browser origins. Unset = no cross-origin browser access (default-deny). An allowlisted origin is reflected exactly in Access-Control-Allow-Origin (never '*'); the list also drives DNS-rebinding origin checks

environmentVariables.name: MCP_ALLOWED_HOSTS
environmentVariables.description: Extra Host header values accepted by DNS-rebinding protection (comma-separated host:port); add your hostname when behind a proxy or container DNS name

environmentVariables.name: CCU_PROFILES
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated names of multiple CCU targets (e.g. 'prod,dev'). Each profile takes the flat CCU_* settings prefixed CCU_<NAME>_ (CCU_PROD_HOST, ...), plus policy flags CCU_<NAME>_PROTECTED (writes need confirm:true) and CCU_<NAME>_READONLY. Unset = single default profile from the flat CCU_* vars

environmentVariables.name: CCU_DEFAULT_PROFILE
environmentVariables.description: Which profile from CCU_PROFILES is active at startup (default: the first listed)

environmentVariables.name: CCU_TLS_VERIFY
environmentVariables.description: Verify the CCU's TLS certificate against the system trust store. Only meaningful with CCU_HTTPS=true. Default false, because a CCU ships a self-signed certificate — prefer CCU_TLS_FINGERPRINT or CCU_CA_CERT to verify one of those

environmentVariables.name: CCU_TLS_FINGERPRINT
environmentVariables.description: Pin the CCU's self-signed leaf certificate by its SHA-256 fingerprint (hex, colons optional). The strongest option for an appliance: the connection is rejected unless the presented certificate matches. Takes precedence over CCU_CA_CERT

environmentVariables.name: CCU_CA_CERT
environmentVariables.description: Path to a PEM file holding the CCU's CA or self-signed certificate. The connection is then validated against it with standard chain verification

environmentVariables.name: CCU_TIMEOUT
environmentVariables.description: Timeout for a CCU JSON-RPC call, in MILLISECONDS

environmentVariables.name: CCU_SCRIPT_TIMEOUT
environmentVariables.description: Timeout for HomeMatic Script execution (ReGa), in MILLISECONDS — scripts are slower than plain API calls

environmentVariables.name: CACHE_TTL
environmentVariables.description: Lifetime of the on-disk device-type schema cache, in SECONDS

environmentVariables.name: CCU_RATE_LIMIT_BURST
environmentVariables.description: Token-bucket burst size for CCU requests — how many may be issued back to back

environmentVariables.name: CCU_RATE_LIMIT_RATE
environmentVariables.description: Sustained CCU request rate, in requests per second

environmentVariables.name: RESOURCE_POLL_INTERVAL
environmentVariables.description: How often MCP resources are polled for change notifications, in SECONDS

environmentVariables.name: LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: error | warn | info | debug. Logs are structured JSON on stderr

environmentVariables.description: Region-specific base URL. Defaults to https://app.coalescesoftware.io (US).

environmentVariables.description: Fallback org ID for cancel-run. Also readable from `orgID` in the active ~/.coa/config profile.

environmentVariables.name: COALESCE_REPO_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Local repo root for repo-backed tools and pipeline planning. Also readable from `repoPath` in the active ~/.coa/config profile.

environmentVariables.name: COALESCE_CACHE_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Base directory for the local data cache. When set, cache files are written here instead of the working directory. Also readable from `cacheDir` in the active ~/.coa/config profile.

environmentVariables.name: COALESCE_MCP_AUTO_CACHE_MAX_BYTES
environmentVariables.description: JSON size threshold before auto-caching to disk. Defaults to 32768.

environmentVariables.name: COALESCE_MCP_INLINE_RESPONSES
environmentVariables.description: Forces large responses inline as text instead of auto-caching them to disk and returning a `resource_link` (and suppresses per-field cache resource links). The server already auto-enables this for clients known not to support MCP resources (e.g. Snowflake Cortex), which otherwise render the link as unreadable "binary data" and retry in a loop. Set `true` to force it on for an unrecognised client, or `false` to disable auto-detection. Leave unset for Claude/Cursor to keep large payloads out of context. Defaults to false (auto-enabled for resource-less clients).

environmentVariables.name: COALESCE_MCP_LINEAGE_TTL_MS
environmentVariables.description: In-memory lineage cache TTL in milliseconds. Defaults to 1800000.

environmentVariables.name: COALESCE_MCP_MAX_REQUEST_BODY_BYTES
environmentVariables.description: Max outbound API request body size. Defaults to 524288.

environmentVariables.name: COALESCE_MCP_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: Default per-request timeout for Coalesce API calls. Raise on large workspaces where paginated reads exceed the default. Defaults to 60000.

environmentVariables.name: COALESCE_MCP_DETAIL_FETCH_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: Per-page timeout for detail=true paginated fetches of large node lists. Defaults to 180000.

environmentVariables.name: COALESCE_MCP_NODE_TYPE_RANKING_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: Deadline for the best-effort workspace-adoption node-type ranking lookup inside node creation. Advisory only — creation proceeds without a ranking suggestion if this trips. Defaults to 15000.

environmentVariables.name: COALESCE_MCP_INVENTORY_CACHE_TTL_MS
environmentVariables.description: In-memory TTL for the workspace node-type inventory. Set to `0` to disable. Defaults to 300000.

environmentVariables.name: COALESCE_MCP_NODE_INDEX_CACHE_TTL_MS
environmentVariables.description: In-memory TTL for the workspace node-index (id/name/type/location) cache used by SQL- and intent-ref resolution. Set to `0` to disable. Defaults to 300000.

environmentVariables.name: COALESCE_MCP_NODE_DETAIL_CACHE_TTL_MS
environmentVariables.description: In-memory TTL for the workspace node-detail (full body) cache used by review and predecessor lookups. Set to `0` to disable. Defaults to 300000.

environmentVariables.name: COALESCE_MCP_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: When `true`, hides all write/mutation tools during registration. Only read, list, search, cache, analyze, review, diagnose, and plan tools are exposed. Defaults to false.

environmentVariables.name: COALESCE_MCP_SKILLS_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Directory for customizable AI skill resources. When set, reads context resources from this directory and seeds defaults on first run. Users can augment or override any skill.

environmentVariables.description: Couchbase connection string. Required for connecting to the cluster.

environmentVariables.name: CB_USERNAME
environmentVariables.description: Couchbase database username. Required for basic authentication.

environmentVariables.name: CB_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: Couchbase database password. Required for basic authentication.

environmentVariables.name: CB_CA_CERT_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Couchbase CA certificate path. Required for TLS authentication in non Capella clusters.

environmentVariables.name: CB_CLIENT_CERT_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Couchbase client certificate path. Required for mTLS authentication.

environmentVariables.name: CB_CLIENT_KEY_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Couchbase client key path. Required for mTLS authentication.

environmentVariables.name: CB_MCP_READ_ONLY_MODE
environmentVariables.description: Couchbase read only mode. Set to true to allow disable write operations across both KV and query. KV write tools are not loaded and SQL++ queries that modify data are blocked. Set to false to allow data modification queries and tools.

environmentVariables.name: CB_MCP_TRANSPORT
environmentVariables.description: Transport mode for the server (stdio, http or sse). Default is stdio

environmentVariables.name: CB_MCP_HOST
environmentVariables.description: Host to run the MCP server on (default: 127.0.0.1). Used only for HTTP and SSE transport modes.

environmentVariables.name: CB_MCP_PORT
environmentVariables.description: Port to run the MCP server on (default: 8000). Used only for HTTP and SSE transport modes.

environmentVariables.name: CB_MCP_DISABLED_TOOLS
environmentVariables.description: Tools to disable. Accepts comma-separated tool names (e.g., 'tool_1,tool_2') or a file path containing one tool name per line.

environmentVariables.name: CB_MCP_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED_TOOLS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated tool names that require user confirmation before execution. Also accepts a file path containing one tool name per line. Requires the MCP client to support elicitation.

environmentVariables.name: CB_MCP_LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: Logging level for the MCP server. One of off, debug, info, warning, error. Use 'off' to disable logging entirely. Invalid values fall back to info. Default is info.

environmentVariables.name: CB_MCP_LOG_SINKS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated list of log destinations. Allowed values: stderr, file. Include 'file' to write per-level log files; include 'stderr' to write to the console. Default is stderr.

environmentVariables.name: CB_MCP_LOG_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Base path for the per-level log files. One rotating file is written per level (e.g. mcp_server.info.log, mcp_server.error.log). Only used when 'file' is in CB_MCP_LOG_SINKS. Default is mcp_server.log.

environmentVariables.name: CB_MCP_LOG_ROTATION_MAX_SIZE_MB
environmentVariables.description: Global maximum size in MB per-level log file before it rotates, inherited by every level unless overridden by a per-level CB_MCP_LOG_<LEVEL>_ROTATION_MAX_SIZE_MB. A value of 0 is invalid and falls back to the default (1 MB) with a startup warning. Default is 1 (1 MB).

environmentVariables.name: CB_MCP_LOG_MAX_BYTES
environmentVariables.description: [DEPRECATED] Global rotation size in bytes; use CB_MCP_LOG_ROTATION_MAX_SIZE_MB (MB) instead. Still honored for backward compatibility but ignored when CB_MCP_LOG_ROTATION_MAX_SIZE_MB is also set. A value of 0 is invalid and falls back to the default with a startup warning.

environmentVariables.name: CB_MCP_LOG_ERROR_ROTATION_MAX_SIZE_MB
environmentVariables.description: Rotation size in MB for the ERROR log file. Overrides CB_MCP_LOG_ROTATION_MAX_SIZE_MB for ERROR; inherits it when unset. 0 is invalid and falls back to the inherited global with a startup warning.

environmentVariables.name: CB_MCP_LOG_WARNING_ROTATION_MAX_SIZE_MB
environmentVariables.description: Rotation size in MB for the WARNING log file. Overrides CB_MCP_LOG_ROTATION_MAX_SIZE_MB for WARNING; inherits it when unset. 0 is invalid and falls back to the inherited global with a startup warning.

environmentVariables.name: CB_MCP_LOG_INFO_ROTATION_MAX_SIZE_MB
environmentVariables.description: Rotation size in MB for the INFO log file. Overrides CB_MCP_LOG_ROTATION_MAX_SIZE_MB for INFO; inherits it when unset. 0 is invalid and falls back to the inherited global with a startup warning.

environmentVariables.name: CB_MCP_LOG_DEBUG_ROTATION_MAX_SIZE_MB
environmentVariables.description: Rotation size in MB for the DEBUG log file. Overrides CB_MCP_LOG_ROTATION_MAX_SIZE_MB for DEBUG; inherits it when unset. 0 is invalid and falls back to the inherited global with a startup warning.

environmentVariables.name: CB_MCP_LOG_RETENTION_BACKUP_COUNT
environmentVariables.description: Number of rotated backup files kept per-level log file, excluding the live file. Applies to every level unless overridden per level. Set to 0 to keep only the live file (still capped by the rotation size). Default is 1.

environmentVariables.name: CB_MCP_LOG_ERROR_RETENTION_BACKUP_COUNT
environmentVariables.description: Rotated backups kept for the ERROR log file. Overrides CB_MCP_LOG_RETENTION_BACKUP_COUNT for ERROR; inherits it when unset.

environmentVariables.name: CB_MCP_LOG_WARNING_RETENTION_BACKUP_COUNT
environmentVariables.description: Rotated backups kept for the WARNING log file. Overrides CB_MCP_LOG_RETENTION_BACKUP_COUNT for WARNING; inherits it when unset.

environmentVariables.name: CB_MCP_OAUTH_JWT_JWKS_URI
environmentVariables.description: JWKS endpoint of the identity provider used to verify bearer JWT signatures. Required to enable OAuth, along with CB_MCP_OAUTH_JWT_ISSUER and CB_MCP_OAUTH_JWT_AUDIENCE. Only honored when CB_MCP_TRANSPORT=http.

environmentVariables.name: CB_MCP_OAUTH_JWT_ISSUER
environmentVariables.description: Expected JWT 'iss' claim value. Also advertised as the authorization server in Protected Resource Metadata when CB_MCP_OAUTH_MCP_BASE_URL is set. Required to enable OAuth.

environmentVariables.name: CB_MCP_OAUTH_JWT_AUDIENCE
environmentVariables.description: Expected JWT 'aud' claim value. Required to enable OAuth.

environmentVariables.name: CB_MCP_OAUTH_JWT_ALGORITHM
environmentVariables.description: JWT signing algorithm. One of RS256/384/512, ES256/384/512, PS256/384/512. Default is RS256.

environmentVariables.name: CB_MCP_OAUTH_MCP_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Public base URL of this MCP server. When set, the server publishes RFC 9728 Protected Resource Metadata at <base_url>/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource/mcp so PRM-aware clients can discover the authorization server. Optional.

environmentVariables.name: CB_MCP_OAUTH_SCOPE_READ_LABEL
environmentVariables.description: Override the OAuth scope label the server treats as 'read' access; advertised in PRM and matched against the token's scope/scp claim. Use when your IdP cannot emit the canonical form. Default is couchbase-mcp:read.

environmentVariables.name: CB_MCP_OAUTH_SCOPE_WRITE_LABEL
environmentVariables.description: Override the OAuth scope label the server treats as 'write' access; same semantics as CB_MCP_OAUTH_SCOPE_READ_LABEL. Default is couchbase-mcp:write.

environmentVariables.description: Total allowance for one Eurostat request across retries, backoff and body consumption, in milliseconds.

environmentVariables.name: EUROSTAT_METADATA_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: Total allowance for one dataset's SDMX dataflow structure across retries, backoff and body consumption, in milliseconds. Defaults to 120000; separate from EUROSTAT_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS for large structures.

environmentVariables.name: EUROSTAT_TOC_CACHE_TTL_MS
environmentVariables.description: How long a fetched catalogue TOC stays usable before the next catalogue call refreshes it, in milliseconds. Defaults to 12 hours.

environmentVariables.name: EUROSTAT_BULK_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: Total allowance for one eurostat_download_dataset transfer across request retries, backoff and streaming body consumption, in milliseconds. Defaults to 120000.

environmentVariables.name: EUROSTAT_BULK_MAX_BYTES
environmentVariables.description: Byte budget for one eurostat_download_dataset transfer, counted on the decoded TSV rather than on the wire. Eurostat sends the body chunked with no Content-Length, so the budget is enforced while streaming and the transfer is aborted when it is reached. Defaults to 50 MiB.

environmentVariables.name: CANVAS_PROVIDER_TYPE
environmentVariables.description: Dataframe canvas backend. The default, 'duckdb', lists the eurostat_dataframe_describe and eurostat_dataframe_query tools, lets eurostat_query_dataset stage a match larger than its 5,000-row inline cap as a SQL table, and lets eurostat_download_dataset retain a whole bulk download instead of only its inline preview. Set to 'none' to disable the canvas and those tools. The DuckDB binding ships with the server, so this variable is the only switch.

environmentVariables.name: CANVAS_TEMP_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Parent directory for DuckDB canvas spill files: a private 'mcp-canvas-XXXXXX' directory is created inside it, so it must be writable by the server process. Defaults to the OS temp directory.

environmentVariables.name: CANVAS_TTL_MS
environmentVariables.description: Sliding lifetime of a staged dataframe canvas in milliseconds; every call against it extends the window. Defaults to 24 hours.

environmentVariables.name: CANVAS_DEFAULT_ROW_LIMIT
environmentVariables.description: Maximum rows a single eurostat_dataframe_query returns before reporting truncated. A separate 64,000-byte budget applies to each serialized response surface, retaining at least one complete row even if oversized.

environmentVariables.name: EUROSTAT_DATAFRAME_DROP_ENABLED
environmentVariables.description: Set to 'true' to list eurostat_dataframe_drop, which removes one staged table from a dataframe canvas and leaves its other tables in place. Off by default because a drop cannot be undone; staged tables expire with their canvas either way. Has no effect with CANVAS_PROVIDER_TYPE=none.

environmentVariables.description: Optional comma-separated vault-relative folder allowlist for reads. Prefix-based with implicit recursion; case-insensitive; trailing slashes normalized. Unset = full vault. Write paths are implicitly readable. Example: 'public/,projects/'.

environmentVariables.description: Global read-only kill switch. When true, every write is denied regardless of OBSIDIAN_WRITE_PATHS, and the command-palette pair is suppressed (commands can mutate). Useful for shared or public-facing deployments.

environmentVariables.description: Opt-in delete confirmation. environmentVariables.description: User-Agent sent to Nominatim and Overpass. Required by usage policy.

environmentVariables.name: OSM_OVERPASS_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Overpass API endpoint URL. When set, pins every query to this one endpoint and disables mirror failover; OSM_OVERPASS_MAX_CONCURRENCY sizes it and a |N suffix is rejected. Leave unset to use OSM_OVERPASS_ENDPOINTS.

environmentVariables.name: OSM_OVERPASS_ENDPOINTS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated ordered list of Overpass endpoints. A failure advances to the next entry within the same tool call; a single entry means no failover. An entry written url|N gets N slots of its own and adds capacity, for an instance whose operator allows parallel queries, never a public FOSSGIS server; an unsuffixed later entry is failover only. Write a | inside a URL as %7C. Verify a mirror's usage policy, data coverage, and freshness before adding it. Ignored when OSM_OVERPASS_BASE_URL is set.

environmentVariables.name: OSM_OVERPASS_MAX_CONCURRENCY
environmentVariables.description: Concurrent Overpass queries per endpoint: OSM_OVERPASS_BASE_URL, and every OSM_OVERPASS_ENDPOINTS entry not sized with |N. With no |N entry it is also the most queries in flight across all endpoints. A query waits at most 30 seconds in total for a slot, then fails with pacer_shed and a retryAfter. The default of 1 follows the public FOSSGIS instances, which allow one query in flight per user; raise it only for an instance whose operator allows parallel queries, such as a private or paid one.

environmentVariables.name: MODEL_NAME
environmentVariables.description: Embedding model name (defaults to Xenova/all-MiniLM-L6-v2)

environmentVariables.name: MAX_FILE_SIZE
environmentVariables.description: Maximum file size in bytes (defaults to 104857600 / 100MB)

environmentVariables.name: RAG_MAX_DISTANCE
environmentVariables.description: Maximum distance threshold for filtering search results. Results with distance greater than this value will be excluded. Lower values mean stricter filtering (e.g., 0.5 for high relevance only)

environmentVariables.name: RAG_GROUPING
environmentVariables.description: Grouping mode for quality filtering. 'similar' returns only the most similar group (stops at first distance jump). 'related' includes related groups (stops at second distance jump). Unset means no grouping filter

environmentVariables.name: RAG_MAX_FILES
environmentVariables.description: Maximum number of files to keep in search results. Results are filtered to include only chunks from the top N best-scoring files. For example, 1 returns only the single best-matching file's chunks. Unset means no file filtering.

environmentVariables.name: CHUNK_MIN_LENGTH
environmentVariables.description: Minimum chunk length in characters (1-10000, defaults to 50). Chunks shorter than this threshold are filtered out during ingestion.

environmentVariables.name: RAG_DEVICE
environmentVariables.description: Execution device for the embedder (defaults to cpu). Passed straight to ONNX Runtime; see the Transformers.js device source for the supported backend names. If the requested device fails to initialize, the server throws an error.

environmentVariables.name: RAG_DTYPE
environmentVariables.description: Embedding quantization dtype for the embedder (defaults to fp32). Opt-in and pass-through; accepts any dtype the chosen model provides (fp32, fp16, q8, int8, ...). If the model has no variant for the requested dtype, the server throws an error. Changing this changes the embedding space — re-ingest existing data.

environmentVariables.name: RAG_HYBRID_WEIGHT
environmentVariables.description: Keyword boost factor for hybrid search (0.0-1.0, defaults to 0.6). 0 means semantic similarity only; higher values increase the keyword-match contribution to the final score.

environmentVariables.name: RAG_WATCH
environmentVariables.description: Enable automatic file watcher to detect changes and re-index modified files (true/1 to enable). Useful during active development.

environmentVariables.name: HF_ENDPOINT
environmentVariables.description: Explicit HuggingFace endpoint URL to use for model downloads. When set, auto-mirror detection is skipped and this URL is used directly. Useful when you have a full-featured mirror.

environmentVariables.name: HF_AUTO_MIRROR
environmentVariables.description: Enable automatic mirror detection for HuggingFace downloads (defaults to true). Set to "false" or "0" to disable and use huggingface.co directly. The mirror chain is: huggingface.co → hf-mirror.com → modelscope.cn.

environmentVariables.name: HTTPS_PROXY
environmentVariables.description: HTTPS proxy URL for downloading embedding models (e.g. http://proxy:8080). Required only if behind a corporate proxy.

environmentVariables.name: HTTP_PROXY
environmentVariables.description: HTTP proxy URL for downloading embedding models. Fallback if HTTPS_PROXY is not set.

environmentVariables.name: ARC_MCP_LABEL

environmentVariables.description: With ARC_MCP_WINDOW=space, the Arc space new tabs open into, when a space with that name exists. Arc will not let a script create a space, so make it by hand. Defaults to "Agent".

environmentVariables.name: ARC_MCP_STATE_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Directory where per-session tab ownership is recorded, so a restarted agent can clean up the tabs its previous run left behind. Defaults to ~/Library/Application Support/arc-control-mcp.

environmentVariables.name: ARC_MCP_WINDOW
environmentVariables.description: "dedicated" keeps agent tabs in one separate agent window, never the user's own. "space" puts them in the Agent space of the user's window. Defaults to "dedicated".

environmentVariables.name: ARC_MCP_WINDOW_PLACEMENT
environmentVariables.description: Where the agent window goes once, at creation: "auto" (largest non-main display, else where Arc puts it), "second-display", "minimized" (experimental) or "none". Needs Accessibility. Defaults to "auto".

environmentVariables.name: ARC_MCP_IDLE_MS
environmentVariables.description: How many milliseconds the user must have been idle before the server does anything visible. 0 turns the activity gate off. Defaults to 1500.

environmentVariables.name: ARC_MCP_IDLE_WAIT_MS
environmentVariables.description: How many milliseconds to wait for that pause before failing with userActive true. Defaults to 15000.

environmentVariables.name: ARC_MCP_ARC_DATA_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Directory the local data tools (sidebar_tree, find_stale_tabs, search_archive, search_history) read Arc's files from. Defaults to ~/Library/Application Support/Arc.

environmentVariables.name: ARC_MCP_ALLOW_HISTORY
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to let search_history run. Off by default, and any other value leaves it off.

environmentVariables.name: ARC_MCP_CDP
environmentVariables.description: Set to 0 to disable the DevTools engine (trusted input, screenshots, console and network capture). On by default, and inert until Arc is launched with --remote-debugging-port.

environmentVariables.name: ARC_MCP_CDP_PORT
environmentVariables.description: The DevTools port to probe on 127.0.0.1. The host is fixed. Defaults to 9222.

environmentVariables.name: ARC_MCP_ALLOWED_ORIGINS
environmentVariables.description: Guardrail. Comma list of origins the agent may touch (host, *.host, scheme://host[:port], file://, about:). Anything not listed is refused. Unset means no allow list.

environmentVariables.name: ARC_MCP_BLOCKED_ORIGINS
environmentVariables.description: Guardrail. Comma list of origins the agent may not touch. Wins over the allow list. Unset means no block list.

environmentVariables.name: ARC_MCP_BLOCK_READS
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to apply the origin lists to read tools as well as changing ones. Off by default.

environmentVariables.name: ARC_MCP_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to expose only the read-only tools. Off by default.

environmentVariables.name: ARC_MCP_AUDIT_LOG
environmentVariables.description: Path of a file that gets one JSON line per changing call (time, tool, tab, origin, ok, error), never typed values or script code. Unset means no audit log.

servers.title: SpecMgr
servers.description: An artifact manager for system specifications.

environmentVariables.name: SPECMGR_MCP_TRANSPORT
environmentVariables.description: Transport mode for the MCP server.

environmentVariables.name: SPECMGR_MCP_HOST
environmentVariables.description: Bind address, SSE/streamable-http mode only.

environmentVariables.name: SPECMGR_MCP_PORT
environmentVariables.description: TCP port, SSE/streamable-http mode only.

environmentVariables.name: SPECMGR_ADR_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Base directory scanned for Architecture Decision Record (.md) files.

environmentVariables.name: SPECMGR_DOCS_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Shared base directory root for the document-type domains that do not have their own dedicated directory environment variable (req, uc, tsk, qa, prb, gol, rsk, dec, sop, vcr, sysrs). Each domain's own subdirectory is appended automatically, e.g. docs/req.

environmentVariables.name: SPECMGR_FEAT_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Base directory scanned for Feature folders (<base>/<id>/README.md).

environmentVariables.name: SPECMGR_SIMILARITY_DISABLED
environmentVariables.description: Presence-based opt-out for the semantic-similarity search feature (the find_related and find_similar_text tools): set to any value to disable the feature, so that every call returns a structured unavailable result and the embedding model is never loaded, and to skip the similarity phase of the unified server-startup warmup thread. Unset by default. Its resolved state is reported by the similarity section of the specmgr://config resource.

environmentVariables.name: SPECMGR_FEAT_WARMUP_DISABLED
environmentVariables.description: Presence-based opt-out for the feat domain's two background cache-warming phases (frontmatter and full-parse) of the unified server-startup warmup thread: set to any value to skip both phases; when set together with SPECMGR_SIMILARITY_DISABLED, no warmup thread is started at all. Unset by default. Its resolved state is reported by the feat_warmup_disabled field of the specmgr://config resource.

environmentVariables.name: SPECMGR_PLANTUML_JAR
environmentVariables.description: Path to a plantuml.jar, one of exactly three PlantUML validation-source selectors (the first one set, in JAR then BIN then URL order, is the only source used; no fall-through, no PATH discovery, no public default; all three unset is the offline structure-only floor). Unset by default. The selected source is reported by the plantuml section of the specmgr://config resource.

environmentVariables.name: SPECMGR_PLANTUML_BIN
environmentVariables.description: Path to an executable speaking the PlantUML CLI contract, one of exactly three PlantUML validation-source selectors (the first one set, in JAR then BIN then URL order, is the only source used; no fall-through, no PATH discovery, no public default; all three unset is the offline structure-only floor). Unset by default. The selected source is reported by the plantuml section of the specmgr://config resource.

environmentVariables.name: SPECMGR_PLANTUML_URL
environmentVariables.description: PlantUML server base URL, one of exactly three PlantUML validation-source selectors (the first one set, in JAR then BIN then URL order, is the only source used; no fall-through, no PATH discovery, no public default; all three unset is the offline structure-only floor). Diagram content is only sent to a PlantUML server if this variable is set. Unset by default. The selected source is reported by the plantuml section of the specmgr://config resource.

environmentVariables.name: SPECMGR_DIAGRAM_MAX_TITLE
environmentVariables.description: Maximum length (in characters) of a resolved node's title label in the reference-graph diagrams (the get_reference_diagram / get_reference_diagram_all MCP tools and the specmgr diagram refs CLI): labels longer than the limit are cut at the last word boundary within the limit (a hard cut when there is none) with an ellipsis appended; the diagram title itself and unresolved node ids are never truncated. An integer; the default 40 applies when the variable is unset or set to an invalid value (empty, non-integer, or less than 1).

environmentVariables.name: SPECMGR_TESTS_NO_DOTENV
environmentVariables.description: Presence-based test/CI sentinel: set to any value to skip the CLI's module-level default .env load entirely, so the process runs under the CI (source-less) condition whatever the local (gitignored) .env configures; this is what keeps the specmgr coverage-badge pre-commit hook's source-less re-run source-less end-to-end. Unset by default, never set outside test runs.

environmentVariables.name: FASTEMBED_CACHE_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Cache directory for the semantic-similarity feature's embedding model (the third-party fastembed backend's own variable, not a SPECMGR_* one): set to a directory to cache the model there; an unset or empty value falls back to the default <tempdir>/fastembed_cache, where <tempdir> is the process's temporary directory (e.g. /tmp on Linux). Unset by default. The resolved directory is reported by the similarity section of the specmgr://config resource.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_ENV_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Path to the .env file that states the destination (the same as the --env-path argument). The file states SAP_URL and SAP_AUTH_TYPE (basic, snc or jwt); a jwt file also states SAP_GRANT_TYPE (authorization_code or none). Without this or --mcp, the server starts in tool-inspection-only mode: nothing is read from the working directory, and SAP_* variables in the process environment alone form no destination.

environmentVariables.name: AUTH_BROKER_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Base directory of service-keys/ and sessions/ for a named destination chosen with the --mcp argument (one directory; a list is not split). Default: ~/.config/mcp-abap-adt (Documents\mcp-abap-adt on Windows).

environmentVariables.name: MCP_BROWSER
environmentVariables.description: Browser for a JWT login: chrome, edge, firefox, system, headless or none.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_BROWSER_AUTH_PORT
environmentVariables.description: Callback port of the JWT browser login, 1-65535.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_UNSAFE
environmentVariables.description: Write a named destination's session to disk (sessions/<name>.env) instead of keeping it in memory.

environmentVariables.name: SAP_CONNECTION_TYPE
environmentVariables.description: Connection type: http or rfc. SNC needs rfc (and the SAP NW RFC SDK).

environmentVariables.name: SAP_SYSTEM_TYPE
environmentVariables.description: System type, required (here or as --system-type; no default, never guessed): the tools offered (e.g. Programs are onprem-only), the connector, and how the system's answers are read. Without it a destination does not start.

environmentVariables.name: SAP_LANGUAGE
environmentVariables.description: Logon language (ISO code, e.g. 'en', 'de').

environmentVariables.name: SAP_MASTER_SYSTEM
environmentVariables.description: System context for on-prem create/update operations (system id).

environmentVariables.name: SAP_RESPONSIBLE
environmentVariables.description: Responsible user for on-prem create/update operations.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_ALLOW_INSECURE_FILE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Set to "true" to allow plain http:// fileUrl downloads in evidence_create (default https-only). Private/internal addresses are rejected regardless (resolution-time check; see the documented DNS TOCTOU limitation in the hosted-deployment runbook).

environmentVariables.name: MCP_ALLOW_UNVERIFIED_BEARER
environmentVariables.description: Escape hatch for MCP_HTTP_PUBLIC=true WITHOUT inbound-token introspection: set to "true" ONLY when an upstream gateway already verifies Bearer tokens. The server logs a prominent warning and forwards tokens upstream unverified.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_ALLOWED_HOSTS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated allowed Host headers. Empty = Host validation disabled (default). When set, requests with a Host outside the list are rejected.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_ALLOWED_ORIGINS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated allowed browser Origins (DNS-rebinding defense). Empty = reject any request carrying an Origin header; non-browser clients (CLI/SDK) send no Origin and are always allowed. Use '*' to allow all.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_API_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Upstream API root. Required: your user key is exchanged for a session token against this host, and the server will not start without it.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_AUTH_USER_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Long-lived EAD Enterprise Suite user key, exchanged automatically for a short-lived session token. Use it for headless or automated access instead of an account password. (See https://www.eadtrust.eu/soluciones-legaltech/enterprise-suite/ for credential acquisition.)

environmentVariables.name: MCP_HTTP_HOST
environmentVariables.description: Interface the HTTP transport binds to. Default 127.0.0.1 (localhost only). Set 0.0.0.0 to expose on all interfaces (containers do this automatically).

environmentVariables.name: MCP_HTTP_MAX_BODY_BYTES
environmentVariables.description: Maximum accepted POST /mcp request-body size in bytes (default 16777216 = 16 MiB — sized so base64 file uploads within the documented tool limits fit). Oversized requests get a 413 JSON-RPC error before/while reading — closes a memory-exhaustion DoS vector in public deployments. Note: base64 file sources are capped by this limit BEFORE MCP_FILE_MAX_BYTES applies.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_HTTP_PUBLIC
environmentVariables.description: Set to "true" for public/multi-tenant deployments. Activates Host validation and refuses to start unless (1) MCP_ALLOWED_ORIGINS or MCP_ALLOWED_HOSTS is set AND (2) inbound Bearer introspection is configured (MCP_SVC_INTROSPECT_URL + MCP_SVC_CLIENT_ID/SECRET) or MCP_ALLOW_UNVERIFIED_BEARER=true is set explicitly (fail-closed).

environmentVariables.name: MCP_SVC_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Client ID this server presents to the introspection endpoint above (its resource-server credentials). Only needed alongside MCP_SVC_INTROSPECT_URL; it does not authenticate you to EAD Enterprise Suite.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_SVC_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Client secret this server presents to the introspection endpoint above (its resource-server credentials). Only needed alongside MCP_SVC_INTROSPECT_URL; it does not authenticate you to EAD Enterprise Suite. (See https://www.eadtrust.eu/soluciones-legaltech/enterprise-suite/ for credential acquisition.)

environmentVariables.name: MCP_SVC_INTROSPECT_URL
environmentVariables.description: RFC 7662 token introspection URL for inbound Bearer verification in HTTP mode. Opt-in, and required when MCP_HTTP_PUBLIC=true. Leave empty for stdio (local) use.

environmentVariables.name: PORT
environmentVariables.description: HTTP port when running in hosted (HTTP) mode; ignored in stdio mode

servers.title: OpenGrok MCP Server
servers.description: MCP server bridging OpenGrok search engine with AI for instant context across massive codebases.

environmentVariables.name: OPENGROK_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: OpenGrok server base URL (e.g. https://opengrok.example.com/source/)

environmentVariables.name: OPENGROK_USERNAME
environmentVariables.description: OpenGrok authentication username. Leave unset for anonymous access.

environmentVariables.name: OPENGROK_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: OpenGrok authentication password. Prefer storing via OS keychain using 'npx opengrok-mcp-server setup'.

environmentVariables.name: OPENGROK_VERIFY_SSL
environmentVariables.description: Verify TLS certificates. Set to false for self-signed or internal CA certs.

environmentVariables.name: OPENGROK_CODE_MODE
environmentVariables.description: Enable Code Mode: 2-tool sandbox interface with env.opengrok.* JavaScript API. Reduces AI token usage by ~90%.

environmentVariables.name: OPENGROK_ENABLE_MEMORY_TOOLS
environmentVariables.description: Register the 3 memory tools in Code Mode (memory status, read, update). Off = api + execute only.

environmentVariables.name: OPENGROK_DEFAULT_PROJECT
environmentVariables.description: Default project to scope all searches. Can be overridden per call.

environmentVariables.name: OPENGROK_CONTEXT_BUDGET
environmentVariables.description: Response size tier controlling token usage.

environmentVariables.name: OPENGROK_API_VERSION
environmentVariables.description: OpenGrok REST API version. Use v2 for call graph features (requires OpenGrok 1.12+).

environmentVariables.name: HTTP_PROXY
environmentVariables.description: HTTP/HTTPS proxy URL for all OpenGrok API requests (e.g. http://proxy.company.com:8080). Also set as HTTPS_PROXY.

environmentVariables.name: OPENGROK_RESPONSE_FORMAT_OVERRIDE
environmentVariables.description: Force a specific response format for all tools. Leave unset for per-tool auto-selection (recommended).

environmentVariables.name: OPENGROK_MEMORY_BANK_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Directory where the AI stores investigation notes (active-task.md, investigation-log.md). Defaults to ~/.config/opengrok-mcp/memory-bank/ or workspace-relative when set by the VS Code extension.

environmentVariables.name: OPENGROK_LOCAL_COMPILE_DB_PATHS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated paths to compile_commands.json for C/C++ compiler flag and include-path extraction. Leave unset for automatic workspace discovery.

environmentVariables.name: OPENGROK_ENABLE_ELICITATION
environmentVariables.description: Interactive AI Prompts — the AI pauses to ask questions during investigations (project selection, file disambiguation). Requires Claude Code v2.1.76+ or a client that supports MCP Elicitation.

environmentVariables.name: OPENGROK_ENABLE_SAMPLING
environmentVariables.description: AI Sampling — allow the server to request LLM completions for error explanations and summaries. Off by default to avoid consuming premium requests (e.g. GitHub Copilot).

environmentVariables.name: OPENGROK_SAMPLING_MODEL
environmentVariables.description: Model preference for MCP Sampling (used for error explanation and query reformulation).

environmentVariables.name: OPENGROK_ENABLE_FILES_API
environmentVariables.description: Files API Cache — avoids re-uploading unchanged investigation notes. Requires Files API support in the MCP client.

environmentVariables.name: OPENGROK_ENABLE_OBSERVATION_MASKER
environmentVariables.description: Observation Masker — prepend compact history summaries to opengrok_execute results after N turns. Disabled by default; has no benefit for clients that retain full context (Claude Code, Cursor).

environmentVariables.name: OPENGROK_OBSERVATION_MASKER_TURNS
environmentVariables.description: Number of most-recent opengrok_execute results to keep as full text before masking older ones. Default: 10.

environmentVariables.name: OPENGROK_SAMPLING_MAX_TOKENS
environmentVariables.description: Maximum tokens for AI sampling responses (error explanation, query reformulation). Range: 64–4096.

environmentVariables.name: OPENGROK_AUDIT_LOG_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Path to write structured audit events (CSV/JSON). Appends tool invocations, elicitation events, and errors. Leave unset to disable.

environmentVariables.name: OPENGROK_RATELIMIT_RPM
environmentVariables.description: Maximum requests per minute to the OpenGrok server. Default: 60.

environmentVariables.name: OPENGROK_PER_TOOL_RATELIMIT
environmentVariables.description: Per-tool rate limits in requests per minute, as comma-separated tool:rpm pairs (e.g. opengrok_execute:15,opengrok_search_code:30). Overrides OPENGROK_RATELIMIT_RPM for specific tools.

environmentVariables.name: OPENGROK_TIMEOUT
environmentVariables.description: HTTP request timeout in seconds for OpenGrok API calls. Increase for slow servers. Default: 30.

environmentVariables.name: OPENGROK_DEFAULT_MAX_RESULTS
environmentVariables.description: Default maximum number of results returned per search query. Default: 25.

environmentVariables.name: OPENGROK_PASSWORD_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Path to a file containing the OpenGrok password (file-mounted secret for containers). Takes precedence over the OS keychain when OPENGROK_PASSWORD is unset.

environmentVariables.name: OPENGROK_MAX_RESPONSE_BYTES
environmentVariables.description: Hard cap on response payload size in bytes. Overrides the context-budget default. Non-positive values are ignored.

environmentVariables.name: OPENGROK_SEARCH_AND_READ_CAP
environmentVariables.description: Cap for the search_and_read compound tool in bytes. Overrides the context-budget default (2–8 KB depending on tier). Non-positive values are ignored.

environmentVariables.name: OPENGROK_STRICT_SSRF
environmentVariables.description: When true, reject OPENGROK_BASE_URL values pointing at private/loopback IPs at startup. Default: false (warn only; per-request guards still apply).

environmentVariables.name: OPENGROK_JWT_ISSUER
environmentVariables.description: Expected JWT issuer (iss claim) for HTTP transport OAuth. When set, JWTs from other issuers are rejected.

environmentVariables.name: OPENGROK_GRAMMAR_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Directory containing tree-sitter WASM grammars. Overrides the bundled grammar lookup.

servers.name: io.github.IlyasKhallouki/hypruse
servers.title: hypruse
servers.description: Computer use for Hyprland: semantic desktop state over IPC, plus vision and native input

environmentVariables.name: HYPRUSE_SCREENSHOT_MODE
environmentVariables.description: How captures are returned: 'file' writes to XDG_RUNTIME_DIR and returns the path, 'image' returns the image inline. Use 'image' for clients that render MCP images but cannot read files, such as Claude Desktop.

environmentVariables.name: HYPRUSE_READONLY
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to expose only the observation tools (desktop, screenshot, zoom, ui, marks, binds, wait_for). The agent can see and narrate but cannot click, type, or launch.

environmentVariables.name: HYPRUSE_CONFINE
environmentVariables.description: Restrict input to a scope of windows and refuse everything outside it: 'launched' (only windows hypruse opened this session), 'class:firefox,kitty', or 'workspace:3,special:notes'. Unset means no confinement.

environmentVariables.name: HYPRUSE_AUTH_GUARD
environmentVariables.description: Refuse to click or type into system authentication dialogs (polkit, keyring prompts). On by default; 'strict' also refuses password fields in ordinary windows; 0 disables it.

environmentVariables.name: HYPRUSE_STRICT
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to refuse to act when the cursor or focused window moved since hypruse's last action, so the agent must re-read the desktop before retrying.

environmentVariables.name: HYPRUSE_MARK
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to make the agent's presence legible: tag every window it opens 'hypruse-owned' and flash an on-screen notice when it opens a window or captures the screen.

environmentVariables.name: HYPRUSE_CLIPBOARD
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to register the opt-in clipboard tool (never in read-only mode). Off by default because clipboards hold passwords.

environmentVariables.name: HYPRUSE_JOURNAL
environmentVariables.description: Record every tool call, refusals included, as one NDJSON line: 1 writes to XDG_STATE_HOME/hypruse/journal.ndjson, or give a path. Read it back with 'hypruse journal'. Off by default.

environmentVariables.name: HYPRUSE_JOURNAL_MAX_BYTES
environmentVariables.description: Rotate the journal once it reaches this size, keeping one previous generation alongside it. Set 0 to never rotate.

environmentVariables.name: HYPRUSE_JOURNAL_TEXT
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to record typed and copied text in the journal verbatim instead of as a length plus digest. Off by default because keystrokes are passwords; needed only to replay typing.

environmentVariables.name: HYPRUSE_DRYRUN
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 for a rehearsal: every acting tool validates its arguments and runs every trust guard, then reports what it would have done and delivers no input.
