environmentVariables.name: IONOS_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: IONOS CLOUD API token (required for all products except Object Storage)

environmentVariables.name: IONOS_S3_ACCESS_KEY
environmentVariables.description: S3 access key for IONOS Object Storage

environmentVariables.name: IONOS_S3_SECRET_KEY
environmentVariables.description: S3 secret key for IONOS Object Storage

environmentVariables.name: IONOS_MCP_LOAD_MODE
environmentVariables.description: Tool registration strategy (the --load-mode flag overrides this). 'eager' (default): register all tools at startup. 'lazy': defer Compute and Object Storage behind 'ionos_load_compute_tools' / 'ionos_load_objectstorage_tools' sentinel tools (requires MCP client support for notifications/tools/list_changed). 'dynamic' (alias 'search'): expose only the ionos_search_tools / ionos_describe_tools / ionos_call_tool meta-tools and browse the full catalog through them — for clients with hard tool caps and no tool search of their own (Cursor, Windsurf).

environmentVariables.name: IONOS_MCP_TOOL_SCOPE
environmentVariables.description: Opt in to write operations. Unset (default) leaves the server read-only: only list_/get_/head_ tools are registered. 'write' additionally registers create_/update_ tools and the non-disruptive actions (start_, resume_, attach_, assign_); 'destructive' also registers delete_ and the disruptive actions (stop_, reboot_, suspend_, upgrade_, restore_, detach_, recreate_, import_) and implies 'write'. Comma-separated, case-insensitive, hierarchical; unrecognised values stay read-only. WARNING: enabling this lets an AI model provision, modify and delete billable resources in a live IONOS CLOUD account. Every create and delete requires a two-phase confirmation, but that cannot stop a client configured to approve tool calls automatically. Leave unset unless writes are needed.

environmentVariables.name: FB_SYSTEM_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: System-user access token (Business Manager). Takes precedence over FB_ACCESS_TOKEN and FB_PAGE_TOKEN when several are set.

environmentVariables.name: FB_ACCESS_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Primary user access token. At least one of FB_SYSTEM_TOKEN, FB_ACCESS_TOKEN or FB_PAGE_TOKEN must be set.

environmentVariables.name: FB_PAGE_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Long-lived Page access token used as a fallback credential when no user or system-user token is configured.

environmentVariables.name: FB_APP_ID
environmentVariables.description: Meta app ID; combined with FB_APP_SECRET it forms the app access token used to authorize /debug_token inspection.

environmentVariables.name: FB_APP_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Meta app secret. When set, appsecret_proof is attached to every call so a stolen bare token cannot be used on its own.

environmentVariables.name: FB_PAGE_ID
environmentVariables.description: Default Facebook Page ID, used when a tool call omits an explicit profile argument.

environmentVariables.name: FB_API_VERSION
environmentVariables.description: Graph API version to target. Defaults to the tested pinned version; other values are accepted verbatim as an escape hatch but are not tested.

environmentVariables.name: FB_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: Per-request timeout in milliseconds; integer in [1, 600000].

environmentVariables.name: FB_HOST_CONCURRENCY
environmentVariables.description: Maximum number of in-flight requests per Graph host; integer in [1, 64].

environmentVariables.name: FB_MAX_RESULT_CHARS
environmentVariables.description: Character budget applied by the result shaper before a tool result is truncated; integer in [500, 10000000].

environmentVariables.name: FB_WRITE_MODE
environmentVariables.description: Write gating mode: plan (validating dry-run preview, the default) or apply. It never covers the irreversible and spend tiers, which always need a per-call apply plus a plan_id.

environmentVariables.name: FB_CONFIRM_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Operator confirmation token for out-of-band approval of irreversible or spend actions. The server prompts through MCP elicitation where the client supports it; otherwise the caller passes this value as the confirm_token tool argument.

environmentVariables.name: FB_MEDIA_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Directory permitted for local media uploads. Unset means URL-only uploads and no local file access at all.

environmentVariables.name: FB_JOURNAL_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Path to the append-only write journal. Defaults to the XDG/%APPDATA% state path; the file is created owner-only (0600) and rotates by size.

environmentVariables.name: FB_TOOL_PACKAGES
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated tool packages or profiles to expose (e.g. core,posts,reader, or the profiles core|all|reader|publisher|moderator|ads). Omit for the default profile, which excludes ads.

environmentVariables.name: FB_PACKAGES_DENY
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated packages to exclude even when FB_TOOL_PACKAGES enables them. Deny wins over allow.

environmentVariables.name: FB_PACKAGES_READONLY
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated packages whose write tools are not registered at all; the read tools of those packages stay available.

environmentVariables.name: FB_TRANSPORT
environmentVariables.description: Transport protocol: stdio (default) or http. The http transport binds 127.0.0.1 only and fails closed without FB_HTTP_TOKEN.

environmentVariables.name: FB_HTTP_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Bearer token guarding the HTTP transport; required when FB_TRANSPORT=http (the server refuses to start without it).

environmentVariables.name: FB_HTTP_PORT
environmentVariables.description: Port for the HTTP transport (loopback only); used when FB_TRANSPORT=http. Integer in [1, 65535].

environmentVariables.name: FB_AD_ACCOUNT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Default ad account ID (act_… or the bare numeric id) for the opt-in ads package.

environmentVariables.name: FB_ADS_BUDGET_CEILING
environmentVariables.description: Hard ceiling for any ads budget write, in minor currency units (e.g. cents). Non-negative integer; a write above it is refused.

environmentVariables.name: FB_LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: Stderr log verbosity: debug, info, warn or error. Logs never go to stdout — that is the stdio protocol channel.

environmentVariables.name: GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS
environmentVariables.description: BigQuery: path to a service-account key file (Application Default Credentials). Required to use the bigquery engine.

environmentVariables.name: SNOWFLAKE_ACCOUNT
environmentVariables.description: Snowflake: account identifier. Required to use the snowflake engine.

environmentVariables.name: SNOWFLAKE_USER
environmentVariables.description: Snowflake: username. Required to use the snowflake engine.

environmentVariables.name: SNOWFLAKE_ROLE
environmentVariables.description: Snowflake: role to assume. Required to use the snowflake engine; has no default and must never be ACCOUNTADMIN (ACCOUNTADMIN, SECURITYADMIN and ORGADMIN are rejected before any Snowflake connection is opened - the check runs when the Snowflake configuration is first loaded, on the first Snowflake tool call; the server process itself starts regardless, so a bad role surfaces as a failed check_credentials or a tool error, not as a startup exit).

environmentVariables.name: SNOWFLAKE_SECONDARY_ROLES
environmentVariables.description: Snowflake: secondary roles activated at login. NONE (default) means only SNOWFLAKE_ROLE is active in the session; ALL is the explicit opt-out that activates every role granted to SNOWFLAKE_USER.

environmentVariables.name: SNOWFLAKE_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Snowflake: path to an RSA private key file for key-pair auth (preferred over SNOWFLAKE_PASSWORD). Either this or SNOWFLAKE_PASSWORD is required to use the snowflake engine.

environmentVariables.name: SNOWFLAKE_PRIVATE_KEY_PASSPHRASE
environmentVariables.description: Snowflake: passphrase for an encrypted SNOWFLAKE_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH key file, if the key is encrypted.

environmentVariables.name: SNOWFLAKE_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: Snowflake: password (discouraged; prefer SNOWFLAKE_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH). Either this or SNOWFLAKE_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH is required to use the snowflake engine.

environmentVariables.name: SNOWFLAKE_EDITION
environmentVariables.description: Snowflake: account edition that sets the USD/credit price of estimates - standard (default), enterprise, business_critical or vps. The per-call edition argument can only raise it.

environmentVariables.name: DATABRICKS_SERVER_HOSTNAME
environmentVariables.description: Databricks: SQL warehouse server hostname (e.g. my-workspace.cloud.databricks.com, no scheme, no trailing slash). Required to use the databricks engine.

environmentVariables.name: DATABRICKS_HTTP_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Databricks: SQL warehouse HTTP path (from the warehouse's Connection Details tab, e.g. /sql/1.0/warehouses/<warehouse-id>). Required to use the databricks engine.

environmentVariables.name: DATABRICKS_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Databricks: personal access token (simplest auth option). Either this or DATABRICKS_CLIENT_ID + DATABRICKS_CLIENT_SECRET is required to use the databricks engine.

environmentVariables.name: DATABRICKS_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Databricks: OAuth machine-to-machine service-principal client ID (preferred for automated use). Requires DATABRICKS_CLIENT_SECRET as well.

environmentVariables.name: DATABRICKS_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Databricks: OAuth machine-to-machine service-principal client secret. Requires DATABRICKS_CLIENT_ID as well.

environmentVariables.name: COST_GUARD_ALLOW_MULTI_STATEMENT_SQL
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to let estimate_query_cost/run_query_bounded accept text containing more than one SQL statement. Off by default: the cost cap is only known to cover the single statement the dry run/EXPLAIN priced. Skips only this server's scanner: Snowflake still rejects multi-statement text (sessions are pinned to MULTI_STATEMENT_COUNT=1), and only a single SELECT/WITH/VALUES statement is wrapped in a LIMIT subquery - a script runs unwrapped and its row cap (max_rows, default 1000) is enforced by the paged fetch.

environmentVariables.name: COST_GUARD_ALLOW_WRITE_STATEMENTS
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 (exactly that value) to let estimate_query_cost/run_query_bounded accept statements that are not reads. Off by default: only text whose first keyword (after comments and opening parentheses) is SELECT, WITH, VALUES, SHOW, DESCRIBE, DESC or EXPLAIN is estimated or run - a WITH must be followed by a SELECT or VALUES - because warehouse rows re-enter the model's context and can steer the next call. The gate is defence in depth: the authorisation boundary is the credential's grants (deploy a read-only principal). With COST_GUARD_ALLOW_MULTI_STATEMENT_SQL=1 every statement in the text must be a read, so BigQuery scripts (DECLARE/SET/BEGIN) need both opt-outs. Any other value leaves the gate on.

environmentVariables.name: COST_GUARD_MAX_IN_FLIGHT_QUERIES
environmentVariables.description: Maximum number of run_query_bounded calls allowed in flight at once (positive integer, default 8). A cancelled call keeps its slot until its warehouse query completes or the 120 s watchdog fires; a call over the cap fails with a tool error naming this variable before any warehouse connection is opened.

environmentVariables.name: COST_GUARD_DATABRICKS_ALLOW_WAREHOUSE_START
environmentVariables.description: Set to true (exactly that value) to let the read-only Databricks tools (check_credentials, estimate_query_cost) open a session on a SQL warehouse that is not RUNNING, which starts the warehouse and bills compute until it auto-stops. Off by default: the server first reads the warehouse's state through the Warehouses API (GET /api/2.0/sql/warehouses/<id>, CAN_VIEW/CAN_USE suffices) and, unless it is RUNNING - also when the state cannot be read - check_credentials returns ok=false and estimate_query_cost returns no byte or dollar figure, without opening a session. run_query_bounded is not gated: its own pre-execution estimate and the execution may start the warehouse. Any other value leaves the guard on.

environmentVariables.name: COST_GUARD_SNOWFLAKE_ALLOW_WAREHOUSE_RESUME
environmentVariables.description: Set to true (exactly that value) to let the read-only Snowflake tools run SELECT CURRENT_REGION(), the INFORMATION_SCHEMA.QUERY_HISTORY read and check_credentials' session-context SELECT on a warehouse that is not STARTED, which can resume a suspended AUTO_RESUME warehouse and bill compute until it auto-suspends. Off by default: those statements are skipped unless the pinned warehouse's SHOW WAREHOUSES state is STARTED (also skipped when no warehouse is pinned or the state cannot be read), and the QUERY_HISTORY read is skipped whenever estimate_query_cost is called without a warehouse argument; estimate_query_cost then prices at Gen1 rates with the byte-tier heuristic and says so in a caveat, and check_credentials returns ok=true with a detail built from the SHOW WAREHOUSES row. USE WAREHOUSE, EXPLAIN USING JSON, SHOW WAREHOUSES and SELECT CURRENT_WAREHOUSE() always run; run_query_bounded is not gated. Any other value leaves the guard on.

servers.name: io.github.mcpsmiths/tracehub-mcp
servers.description: Query OTel traces across Jaeger, Tempo, Traceloop, Datadog, Sentry, X-Ray, New Relic, Honeycomb.

environmentVariables.name: BACKEND_TYPE
environmentVariables.description: Which observability backend to query.

environmentVariables.name: BACKEND_URL
environmentVariables.description: Backend API endpoint, e.g. http://localhost:16686 for Jaeger, https://api.datadoghq.com for Datadog, https://api.newrelic.com/graphql for New Relic, or https://api.honeycomb.io for Honeycomb. For the X-Ray backend this is decorative only (e.g. https://xray.us-east-1.amazonaws.com) - never dereferenced for a live request.

environmentVariables.name: BACKEND_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API key or auth token. Required for Traceloop, Datadog, Sentry, New Relic, and Honeycomb; not used by Jaeger, Tempo, or X-Ray. For New Relic this must be a User API key, not an Ingest or License key; for Honeycomb this must be a Configuration Key, not an Ingest or Management key.

environmentVariables.name: BACKEND_AWS_REGION
environmentVariables.description: AWS region, e.g. us-east-1. Required for the X-Ray backend only - X-Ray authenticates via boto3's standard AWS credential chain, not BACKEND_API_KEY.

environmentVariables.name: BACKEND_NEWRELIC_ACCOUNT_ID
environmentVariables.description: New Relic account ID, required for the New Relic backend only - NerdGraph queries are user-scoped, not account-scoped, so this identifies which account's data to read.

environmentVariables.name: BACKEND_HONEYCOMB_DATASET
environmentVariables.description: Honeycomb dataset slug, required for the Honeycomb backend only - the Query Data API is dataset-scoped.

environmentVariables.name: BACKEND_APP_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Datadog Application key, required in addition to BACKEND_API_KEY for the Datadog backend only.

environmentVariables.name: BACKEND_TEMPO_INSTANCE_ID
environmentVariables.description: Grafana Cloud stack/instance ID, used with BACKEND_API_KEY for Basic Auth (Tempo backend only, required for Grafana Cloud-hosted Tempo, not needed for self-hosted Tempo).

environmentVariables.name: BACKEND_SENTRY_ORG
environmentVariables.description: Sentry organization slug, required for the Sentry backend only.

environmentVariables.name: BACKEND_SENTRY_PROJECT
environmentVariables.description: Sentry project slug, optional for the Sentry backend - narrows queries to one project.

environmentVariables.name: BACKEND_ENVIRONMENTS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated environments for the Traceloop backend only.

environmentVariables.name: BACKEND_TIMEOUT
environmentVariables.description: Request timeout in seconds.

environmentVariables.name: BACKEND_MAX_RESPONSE_BYTES
environmentVariables.description: Ceiling on the decoded size of any single backend response, in bytes (1 to 1073741824). An oversized body is refused before it is buffered or parsed.

environmentVariables.name: LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: Logging level.

environmentVariables.name: MAX_TRACES_PER_QUERY
environmentVariables.description: Maximum traces validated per query (1-1000).

environmentVariables.name: SLOW_REQUEST_THRESHOLD_MS
environmentVariables.description: Logs a WARNING for any backend request slower than this, independent of LOG_LEVEL. Unset disables slow-request logging.

environmentVariables.name: QUERY_CACHE_TTL_SECONDS
environmentVariables.description: Cache backend query results for this many seconds with in-flight request coalescing; finite, > 0 and at most 86400 (one day). Unset disables the cache.

environmentVariables.name: QUERY_CACHE_MAX_ENTRIES
environmentVariables.description: Upper bound on the number of cached query results held at once (1-100000); the least-recently-used entry is evicted first.

environmentVariables.name: OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT
environmentVariables.description: Enables opt-in OTel self-instrumentation of tool calls when set. Unset means zero overhead - no TracerProvider is configured and no middleware is registered.

environmentVariables.name: OTEL_SERVICE_NAME
environmentVariables.description: Service name reported in self-instrumentation spans, only used when OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT is set.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_INCLUDE_ARGS_IN_SPANS
environmentVariables.description: Include tool call arguments/results as OTel span attributes when self-instrumentation is enabled. Off by default since they may contain sensitive data.

environmentVariables.name: APPLE_SAFARI_ALLOW_WRITES
environmentVariables.description: Register the mutating tools. Off by default, and the gate decides whether the write tools exist at all rather than merely refusing — an agent with writes off cannot see them.

environmentVariables.name: APPLE_SAFARI_ALLOW_CODES
environmentVariables.description: Return one-time codes: a one-time-code field in apple_safari_page_elements, and apple_safari_find_codes for a code a page shows as text. Its own gate rather than allowWrites, because it is a read. Credential fields stay redacted whatever this says.

environmentVariables.name: APPLE_SAFARI_ALLOW_NETWORK
environmentVariables.description: Register apple_safari_network_record, _list and _get, which record what a page you allowed the extension on fetches and read the responses. Its own gate rather than allowWrites, because it is a read; off means the tools do not exist. Headers named like credentials are masked, bodies are not. Reloading a tab to record and saving a body to a file still need APPLE_SAFARI_ALLOW_WRITES.

environmentVariables.name: APPLE_SAFARI_DOWNLOAD_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Where apple_safari_network_get's saveAs writes a file. Defaults to ~/Downloads. A name is kept to its basename and an existing file is never replaced unless asked.

environmentVariables.name: APPLE_SAFARI_NETWORK_CHUNK_CHARS
environmentVariables.description: Characters of a body the server asks the page for per command when it reads a large body. Defaults to 262144, which was measured to work; how far above that Safari's native-message channel goes is unmeasured.

environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to enable MCP authentication (the composite token verifier + Resource-Server wiring); off by default.

environmentVariables.name: REBAR_MCP_AUTH_STRATEGIES
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated, ordered list of token-verifier strategies to compose (closed set: static, jwt, introspection, proxy, custom).

environmentVariables.name: REBAR_MCP_AUTH_ISSUER_URL
environmentVariables.description: OAuth authorization-server issuer URL advertised in the Protected-Resource Metadata (RFC 9728) when auth is enabled.

environmentVariables.name: REBAR_MCP_AUTH_RESOURCE_SERVER_URL
environmentVariables.description: The single resource identifier (RFC 8707 audience) for this server; the composite verifier re-checks every accepted token against it.

environmentVariables.name: REBAR_MCP_AUTH_REQUIRED_SCOPES
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated scopes a caller must hold; the SDK returns 403 insufficient_scope when a principal lacks one.

environmentVariables.name: REBAR_MCP_AUTH_STATIC_TOKENS_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Path to the JSON secrets file for the static-bearer verifier (stores only SHA-256 digests of the accepted tokens).

environmentVariables.name: REBAR_MCP_AUTH_JWT_JWKS_URI
environmentVariables.description: HTTPS JWKS endpoint the `jwt` verifier fetches signing keys from (an OIDC provider's .well-known/jwks.json).

environmentVariables.name: REBAR_MCP_AUTH_JWT_ISSUER
environmentVariables.description: Expected `iss` claim for the `jwt` verifier; falls back to REBAR_MCP_AUTH_ISSUER_URL when unset.

environmentVariables.name: REBAR_MCP_AUTH_JWT_ALGORITHMS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated PINNED, asymmetric-only JWS algorithms for the `jwt` verifier (default RS256,ES256); a symmetric algorithm on a JWKS source is refused.

environmentVariables.name: REBAR_MCP_AUTH_JWT_LEEWAY
environmentVariables.description: Clock-skew leeway in seconds applied to exp/nbf validation by the `jwt` verifier (default 60).

environmentVariables.name: REBAR_MCP_AUTH_JWT_JWKS_REFETCH_COOLDOWN
environmentVariables.description: Minimum seconds between JWKS refetches triggered by an unknown key id (the concurrency-safe flood guard; default 30).

environmentVariables.name: REBAR_MCP_AUTH_JWT_JWKS_TIMEOUT
environmentVariables.description: HTTP timeout in seconds for the `jwt` verifier's JWKS fetch (default 10).

environmentVariables.name: REBAR_MCP_AUTH_JWT_EXPECTED_TYP
environmentVariables.description: When set, the `jwt` verifier requires the JWT header `typ` to equal this (e.g. at+JWT per RFC 9068); unset skips the check.

environmentVariables.name: REBAR_MCP_AUTH_JWT_ALLOW_PRIVATE_JWKS_HOST
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to permit a private/link-local/loopback JWKS host (SSRF guard is on by default); off by default.

environmentVariables.name: REBAR_MCP_AUTH_INTROSPECTION_ENDPOINT
environmentVariables.description: The `introspection` verifier's RFC 7662 endpoint URL (must be https://); the opaque token is POSTed here on every request (no caching).

environmentVariables.name: REBAR_MCP_AUTH_INTROSPECTION_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: The client id the `introspection` verifier presents to the Authorization Server via HTTP Basic (client_secret_basic).

environmentVariables.name: REBAR_MCP_AUTH_INTROSPECTION_CLIENT_SECRET_ENV
environmentVariables.description: The NAME of the env var holding the introspection client secret (never the secret itself); must be present + non-empty at startup or the server refuses to start (fail-closed).

environmentVariables.name: REBAR_MCP_AUTH_INTROSPECTION_ALLOW_PRIVATE_HOST
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to permit a private/link-local/loopback introspection endpoint host (SSRF guard is on by default); off by default.

environmentVariables.name: REBAR_MCP_AUTH_INTROSPECTION_ALLOW_MISSING_AUD
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to accept an active introspection response that OMITS `aud` (many AS do); off by default (fail-closed reject).

environmentVariables.name: REBAR_MCP_AUTH_PROXY_SECRET_ENV
environmentVariables.description: The NAME of the env var holding the trusted-proxy shared secret (never the secret itself); must be present + non-empty at startup or the `proxy` verifier refuses to start (fail-closed).

environmentVariables.name: REBAR_MCP_AUTH_PROXY_SECRET_HEADER
environmentVariables.description: The header the fronting proxy sends its shared secret on; the identity is trusted only when this matches (constant-time; default x-proxy-auth).

environmentVariables.name: REBAR_MCP_AUTH_PROXY_IDENTITY_HEADER
environmentVariables.description: The header carrying the proxy-authenticated principal identity, trusted only when the secret header validates (default x-forwarded-user).

environmentVariables.name: REBAR_MCP_AUTH_PROXY_SCOPES
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated fixed scope set granted to proxy-authenticated principals; empty by default (the principal holds no scopes).

environmentVariables.name: REBAR_MCP_AUTH_CUSTOM_IMPORT
environmentVariables.description: The `custom` strategy's `module:factory` import string, resolving to a factory that returns a TokenVerifier; a TRUSTED operator config value that loads and executes the operator-configured code at startup (fail-closed on any load error).

environmentVariables.name: SMTP_HOST
environmentVariables.description: Hostname of the SMTP server, e.g. smtp.example.net.

environmentVariables.name: SMTP_PORT
environmentVariables.description: Port. Defaults to 587 for starttls, 465 for implicit, 25 for none.

environmentVariables.name: SMTP_TLS
environmentVariables.description: starttls (default), implicit or none. STARTTLS is required, never opportunistic.

environmentVariables.name: SMTP_USER
environmentVariables.description: Username for SMTP authentication.

environmentVariables.name: SMTP_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: Password or app-specific password for SMTP authentication.

environmentVariables.name: SMTP_FROM
environmentVariables.description: The only sender this server will use, e.g. "Name <person@example.net>". There is no from parameter.

environmentVariables.name: SMTP_REPLY_TO
environmentVariables.description: Reply-To header on every message, e.g. "Team <team@example.net>". Unset means no Reply-To header and replies go to SMTP_FROM. There is no reply_to parameter.

environmentVariables.name: SMTP_ALLOW_SEND
environmentVariables.description: Set to "true" to register the sending tools. Defaults to false: the server cannot send until it is set.

environmentVariables.name: SMTP_ALLOWED_RECIPIENTS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated addresses and @domains this server may write to. Required with SMTP_ALLOW_SEND=true; "*" allows any.

environmentVariables.name: SMTP_MAX_RECIPIENTS
environmentVariables.description: Maximum distinct recipients across To, Cc and Bcc in one message. Default 10.

environmentVariables.name: SMTP_MAX_SENDS_PER_HOUR
environmentVariables.description: Sliding hourly cap on messages sent. Default 20.

environmentVariables.name: SMTP_MAX_MESSAGE_BYTES
environmentVariables.description: Maximum size of the composed message. Default 10485760.

environmentVariables.name: SMTP_MAX_ATTACHMENT_BYTES
environmentVariables.description: Maximum size of a single attachment. Default 5242880.

environmentVariables.name: SMTP_ATTACHMENT_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Directory attachments are read from. Unset means attachments are unavailable.

environmentVariables.name: SMTP_ATTACHMENT_TYPES
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated content types that may be attached. Defaults to a document and image allowlist.

environmentVariables.name: SMTP_SIGNATURE
environmentVariables.description: Text appended below the standard signature delimiter of every message.

environmentVariables.name: SMTP_AUDIT_LOG
environmentVariables.description: File the audit lines are appended to, in addition to stderr.

environmentVariables.name: SMTP_ALLOW_TOOLS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated tool names, a prefix with one trailing *, or "essential" for the curated preset.

environmentVariables.name: SMTP_DENY_TOOLS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated tool names or prefixes to remove, applied after SMTP_ALLOW_TOOLS.

environmentVariables.name: SMTP_INSECURE_TLS
environmentVariables.description: Set to "true" to accept self-signed certificates. Prefer a proper internal CA.

environmentVariables.name: PDFNATIVE_MCP_CACHE_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Opt-in content-addressed response cache directory (SHA-256 keyed, 1h TTL, 256 MiB LRU, plaintext at rest). Never caches encrypt/decrypt, sign, timestamp, add_ltv, update_metadata, encrypted builds or file output.

environmentVariables.name: PDFNATIVE_MCP_PORT
environmentVariables.description: Serve Streamable HTTP on this loopback port instead of stdio (MCP 2026-07-28, stateless). Unauthenticated unless PDFNATIVE_MCP_HTTP_TOKEN is set.

environmentVariables.name: PDFNATIVE_MCP_HTTP_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Opt-in bearer token for the HTTP transport (>= 16 chars, no whitespace). When set, /mcp requires 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' or answers 401. Never logged.

environmentVariables.name: PDFNATIVE_MCP_MAX_INFLATE_BYTES
environmentVariables.description: Per-stream FlateDecode decompression cap in bytes (zip-bomb mitigation; default 104857600 = 100 MiB). Integer >= 1024; an invalid value refuses to start the server.

environmentVariables.name: PDFNATIVE_MCP_CREATION_DATE
environmentVariables.description: ISO 8601 instant with a time zone (e.g. 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z) pinned as the creation date of every generated document: reproducible bytes on any host. A call's own creationDate still wins. An invalid value refuses to start the server.

environmentVariables.name: SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH
environmentVariables.description: reproducible-builds.org convention: integer seconds since the Unix epoch, used as the pinned creation date when PDFNATIVE_MCP_CREATION_DATE is unset. An invalid value refuses to start the server.

environmentVariables.name: PDFNATIVE_MCP_TSA_URL
environmentVariables.description: http(s) URL of the RFC 3161 timestamp authority used by sign_pdf timestamp=true and timestamp_pdf (PAdES B-T / B-LTA). Unset: those calls fail with TSA_NOT_CONFIGURED and no network request is made. Tool arguments can never supply a URL.

environmentVariables.name: PDFNATIVE_MCP_TSA_AUTH
environmentVariables.description: Optional Authorization header value sent to the TSA (e.g. 'Basic ...' or 'Bearer ...'). Never logged or echoed.

environmentVariables.name: PDFNATIVE_MCP_REVOCATION
environmentVariables.description: 'ocsp', 'crl' or 'ocsp,crl': enables online revocation collection for add_ltv mode='online' (PAdES B-LT). Unset: that mode fails with REVOCATION_NOT_CONFIGURED; mode='offline' stays fully offline. Requires PDFNATIVE_MCP_NETWORK_ALLOWED_HOSTS.

environmentVariables.name: PDFNATIVE_MCP_NETWORK_ALLOWED_HOSTS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated allow-list of OCSP / CRL responder hosts ('host', 'host:port' or '*.suffix'). Mandatory when PDFNATIVE_MCP_REVOCATION is set: responder URLs found in certificates are fetched only if the host matches (http(s) only, no credentials, no redirects, internal addresses rejected unless listed verbatim).

environmentVariables.name: PDFNATIVE_MCP_NETWORK_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: Per-request timeout for TSA / OCSP / CRL calls in milliseconds, 1000-120000 (default 10000).

servers.name: io.github.Nizoka/pkinative-mcp
servers.title: pkinative MCP — X.509, CMS, OCSP, time-stamps and PKCS#12 without a key byte leaving
servers.description: PKI MCP server: inspect, verify, issue, sign X.509, CSR, CRL, OCSP, CMS, TSP, PKCS#12. 34 tools

environmentVariables.name: PKINATIVE_MCP_OUTPUT_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Absolute path of the one sandbox directory: path inputs are read from it and outputMode='file' outputs are written under it (never overwritten; the real path of every file read and of every parent written must stay inside — a planted symlink or junction is SECURITY_VIOLATION). Key-bearing files (.key .p8 .p12 .pfx) are read by the key tools only, never written, never served as resources. Unset: every tool works on inline PEM / base64 only.

environmentVariables.name: PKINATIVE_MCP_CACHE_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Opt-in content-addressed response cache directory (SHA-256 keyed, 1h TTL, 256 MiB LRU, plaintext at rest). Never caches path inputs, file output, a call carrying a password or a signer, a clock-dependent instant, a random serial or nonce, describe_engine or draft_governance_issue.

environmentVariables.name: PKINATIVE_MCP_PORT
environmentVariables.description: Serve Streamable HTTP on this loopback port (POST /mcp) instead of stdio (MCP 2026-07-28, stateless, legacy fallback). Unauthenticated unless PKINATIVE_MCP_HTTP_TOKEN is set.

environmentVariables.name: PKINATIVE_MCP_HTTP_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Opt-in bearer token for the HTTP transport (>= 16 chars, no whitespace; a weaker value refuses to start). When set, /mcp requires 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' or answers 401. Compared constant-time, never logged.

environmentVariables.name: PKINATIVE_MCP_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: Operator-side password of the encrypted PKCS#8 key or PKCS#12 file the tools open (keeps the secret out of the model transcript). Exclusive with the per-call password input (both at once is VALIDATION_ERROR). Never logged; only its presence is reported at startup.

environmentVariables.name: PKINATIVE_MCP_AT
environmentVariables.description: Pinned instant (ISO 8601 or epoch milliseconds) every omitted at / notBefore / signingTime falls back to, for reproducible verdicts and artefacts. Unset: the wall clock (a clock-dependent result is never cached). An invalid value refuses to start.

environmentVariables.name: PKINATIVE_MCP_MAX_INPUT_BYTES
environmentVariables.description: Operator ceiling for limits.maxInputBytes and the decoded size of one PKI object (default 67108864 = 64 MiB, the engine default). Integer >= 1024, read once at startup; an invalid value refuses to start. A per-call value above it is refused with LIMIT_CEILING_EXCEEDED.

environmentVariables.name: PKINATIVE_MCP_MAX_KDF_ITERATIONS
environmentVariables.description: Operator ceiling for limits.maxKdfIterations and limits.maxPkcs12KdfIterations (default 10000000, the engine default): the CPU bound of a hostile PBES2 key or PKCS#12 file. Integer >= 1, read once at startup; an invalid value refuses to start.

environmentVariables.name: PKINATIVE_MCP_MAX_PATHS_EXPLORED
environmentVariables.description: Operator ceiling for limits.maxPathsExplored (default 1000, the engine default): the RFC 5280 section 6 path-building work bound. Integer >= 1, read once at startup; an invalid value refuses to start.

environmentVariables.name: ZIPNATIVE_MCP_OUTPUT_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Absolute path of the one sandbox directory: zipPath / sourcePath inputs are read from it and outputMode='file' / outputDir outputs are written under it (never overwritten; the real path of every file read and of every parent written must stay inside — a planted symlink or junction is SECURITY_VIOLATION). Unset: every tool works on base64 only (no file I/O beyond the opt-in cache).

environmentVariables.name: ZIPNATIVE_MCP_CACHE_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Opt-in content-addressed response cache directory (absolute path) (SHA-256 keyed, 1h TTL, 256 MiB, oldest-written evicted first, plaintext at rest). Never caches zipPath / sourcePath inputs, file output, defaultDate='now', parallel, describe_engine or draft_governance_issue.

environmentVariables.name: ZIPNATIVE_MCP_PORT
environmentVariables.description: Serve Streamable HTTP on this loopback port (POST /mcp) instead of stdio (MCP 2026-07-28, stateless, legacy fallback). Unauthenticated unless ZIPNATIVE_MCP_HTTP_TOKEN is set.

environmentVariables.name: ZIPNATIVE_MCP_HTTP_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Opt-in bearer token for the HTTP transport (>= 16 chars, no whitespace; a weaker value refuses to start). When set, /mcp requires 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' or answers 401. Compared constant-time, never logged.

environmentVariables.name: ZIPNATIVE_MCP_MAX_UNCOMPRESSED_BYTES
environmentVariables.description: Operator ceiling for limits.maxEntryUncompressedSize, limits.maxTotalUncompressedSize and limits.maxEntryCompressedSize in bytes (default 8589934592 = 8 GiB, the engine default). Integer >= 1024, read once at startup; an invalid value refuses to start. A per-call value above it is refused with LIMIT_CEILING_EXCEEDED.

environmentVariables.name: ZIPNATIVE_MCP_MAX_ENTRIES
environmentVariables.description: Operator ceiling for limits.maxEntries and scan_zip_forward maxEntries (default 100000, the engine default; the scanner's default budget of 10000 is clamped to it, only an explicit value above it is refused). Integer >= 1, read once at startup; an invalid value refuses to start.

environmentVariables.name: ZIPNATIVE_MCP_WORKERS
environmentVariables.description: Operator ceiling for create_zip parallel.workers (default 8; with no explicit workers the engine default max(1, min(cores - 1, 8)) applies, bounded by this ceiling; 0 disables worker threads and keeps compression on the calling thread). Integer >= 0, read once at startup; an invalid value refuses to start.

environmentVariables.name: ZIPNATIVE_MCP_MAX_FILE_OUTPUT_BYTES
environmentVariables.description: Operator ceiling for every file written in outputMode='file' (create_zip, modify_zip, canonicalize_zip, merge_zip, extract_zip, inflate_raw), enforced while streaming (default 4294967296 = 4 GiB, the 1.0.0 behaviour). Integer >= 1048576, read once at startup; an invalid value refuses to start. Raise it to write Zip64 archives above 4 GiB into the sandbox (create_zip stream entries with zip64: true).

environmentVariables.description: Sandbox root directory that the fs-category file tools (read_file/write_file/list_dir/stat_path/make_dir/copy_file/move_file/delete_file) are confined to when fs tools are enabled; open_path's path argument is honored too.

environmentVariables.name: UMBRIEL_TRACE
environmentVariables.description: File path to journal every mutating tool call as JSON Lines (tool, category, masked args, ok, observation); secret-bearing args and values are redacted. Unset = no trace.

environmentVariables.name: UMBRIEL_FFI_TRACE
environmentVariables.description: File path to a flush-before-call diagnostic journal of every COM vcall (slot, this-pointer, arg count). Each line is written and flushed to the OS BEFORE the native call, so after an uncatchable crash the last line names the faulting call. Has per-call overhead; unset = off. For debugging native faults only.

environmentVariables.name: UMBRIEL_AUDIT
environmentVariables.description: Controls the default-on stderr audit of mutating tool calls. 'off' is the explicit opt-out (reported at startup); 'verbose' also audits reads.

environmentVariables.name: UMBRIEL_REDACT
environmentVariables.description: Credential masking (default on). 'off' opts out; a regex value overrides the built-in secret shapes masked in clipboard/env/registry reads and the trace journal.

environmentVariables.name: CODEX_SUBAGENT_MAX_BACKGROUND_JOBS
environmentVariables.description: Cap on running background jobs: decimal integer 1 to 8 (default 8). Blocking calls do not use this cap.

environmentVariables.description: Opt-in local usage log: on or off (default off). Records counts and settings, never prompts, code or paths; labels are caller text.

environmentVariables.name: CODEX_SUBAGENT_DEFAULT_MODEL
environmentVariables.description: Model used when a call names none. Unset: the only entry of a single-entry CODEX_SUBAGENT_ALLOWED_MODELS, otherwise a call without a model is refused with a suggestion.

environmentVariables.name: CODEX_SUBAGENT_DEFAULT_EFFORT
environmentVariables.description: Reasoning effort used when a call specifies none: none, minimal, low, medium, high, xhigh, max or ultra. Unset: the model's own default. Cannot exceed CODEX_SUBAGENT_MAX_EFFORT.

environmentVariables.name: CODEX_SUBAGENT_ALLOWED_MODELS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated allow-list of model slugs; anything else is refused. Unset: unrestricted. A single entry acts as the default model; an empty entry is a configuration error.

environmentVariables.name: CODEX_SUBAGENT_DEFAULT_SANDBOX
environmentVariables.description: Sandbox used when a call specifies none: read-only, workspace-write or danger-full-access. Defaults to read-only and cannot exceed the ceiling.

environmentVariables.name: CODEX_SUBAGENT_MAX_SANDBOX
environmentVariables.description: Ceiling on what a delegation may do: read-only, workspace-write or danger-full-access. Defaults to workspace-write; danger-full-access must be set explicitly.

environmentVariables.name: CODEX_SUBAGENT_MAX_EFFORT
environmentVariables.description: Ceiling on reasoning effort: none, minimal, low, medium, high, xhigh, max or ultra. Unset: unrestricted. Higher efforts are lowered to a supported level, or refused if none fits.

environmentVariables.name: CODEX_SUBAGENT_MCP_SERVERS
environmentVariables.description: MCP servers from Codex's config a delegation keeps: none (default), all, or comma-separated names.

environmentVariables.name: CODEX_SUBAGENT_PLUGINS
environmentVariables.description: Installed Codex plugins a delegation keeps: none (default), all, or comma-separated name@marketplace ids.

environmentVariables.name: CODEX_SUBAGENT_APPS
environmentVariables.description: Whether a delegation keeps Codex's apps (connectors to external services): off (default) or on.

environmentVariables.name: CODEX_BIN
environmentVariables.description: Codex executable name or path. Unset: codex, searched on PATH. On Windows it must run directly, such as codex.exe; a .cmd or .bat shim is refused.

servers.name: io.github.piprail/mcp
servers.title: PipRail
servers.description: Budget-bound x402 payment wallet for AI agents — pays HTTP 402 URLs, capped locally. No backend.

environmentVariables.name: PIPRAIL_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Your wallet's private key/seed for the chosen chain. Optional: omit it to run read-only (discover/quote/register/budget/guide); set it to let the agent pay. Stays on your machine; the spend policy caps every payment.

environmentVariables.name: PIPRAIL_CHAIN
environmentVariables.description: Chain to pay on (default: base).

environmentVariables.name: PIPRAIL_CHAINS
environmentVariables.description: Pay across several chains (instead of PIPRAIL_CHAIN): a comma-separated list, e.g. base,polygon,solana. Give each its own PIPRAIL_<CHAIN>_KEY (+ optional PIPRAIL_<CHAIN>_RPC_URL). The agent pays whichever chain a 402 asks for — the first listed that can settle — under one shared budget.

environmentVariables.name: PIPRAIL_MAX_AMOUNT
environmentVariables.description: Max spend per single payment, in token units (default: 0.10).

environmentVariables.name: PIPRAIL_MAX_TOTAL
environmentVariables.description: Lifetime spend cap per token, in token units (default: 10.00).

environmentVariables.name: PIPRAIL_MAX_TOTAL_DENOM
environmentVariables.description: Cross-token GRAND TOTAL: one spend cap per denomination across every stablecoin and chain, e.g. USD:20.00,EUR:5.00. Not a price oracle — sums tokens of the same unit, each counted 1:1. Native coins are excluded.

environmentVariables.name: PIPRAIL_MAX_PAYMENTS
environmentVariables.description: Lifetime cap on the NUMBER of payments, across every chain + token (e.g. 100).

environmentVariables.name: PIPRAIL_MAX_PAYMENTS_PER_WINDOW
environmentVariables.description: Cap on the number of payments within PIPRAIL_WINDOW_SECONDS (a rolling rate limit; set PIPRAIL_WINDOW_SECONDS too).

environmentVariables.name: PIPRAIL_WARN_AT_FRACTION
environmentVariables.description: Emit an early-warning event when spend crosses this fraction of any cap, e.g. 0.8 (80%). Needs PIPRAIL_EVENT_LOG to be visible.

environmentVariables.name: PIPRAIL_SPEND_LOG
environmentVariables.description: Path to a local append-only spend log. When set, the budget (lifetime, grand total, counts) SURVIVES a restart — hydrated from this file. No backend; you own the file.

environmentVariables.name: PIPRAIL_EVENT_LOG
environmentVariables.description: Mirror payment events (settled / declined / budget-threshold) as one-line JSON to 'stderr' or a file path — the operator's notification stream. Default: off.

environmentVariables.name: PIPRAIL_TOKENS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated allowed token symbols, plus the alias 'native' for the chain's coin (default: USDC).

environmentVariables.name: PIPRAIL_SCHEMES
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated payment schemes to settle (default: onchain-proof). Add 'exact' (onchain-proof,exact) to also pay standard x402 servers GASLESS on EVM + Solana (method auto-selected). Add 'upto' to also pay metered x402 servers on EVM (Permit2): sign a MAX, the server settles the actual <= max.

environmentVariables.name: CONFIG
environmentVariables.description: Path to your configuration file

environmentVariables.name: MCP_ALLOW_STATIC_FALLBACK
environmentVariables.description: Set to 'true' to allow HTTP startup when config.json has static credentials. Otherwise the server refuses to start, preventing silent shared-identity fallback for unauthenticated requests.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_CONTENT_MAX_BYTES
environmentVariables.description: Byte cap for the content bodies and result blocks tools return (wikitext, rendered HTML, diffs, statement and row listings). An oversized response is truncated with a trailing marker describing what was left out.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_FILE_DATA_MAX_BYTES
environmentVariables.description: Hard cap on the base64-encoded size of a get-file-data response. A transport/safety backstop; callers tune actual size with the tool's width parameter. Over-cap responses error rather than truncate.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: Minimum severity for logger output (stderr telemetry and sendLoggingMessage broadcast). Invalid values fail loudly on first log call.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_MAX_REQUEST_BODY
environmentVariables.description: Maximum HTTP request body size on the StreamableHTTP transport. Accepts size strings like 1mb or 512kb.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_METRICS
environmentVariables.description: Set to 'true' to expose Prometheus metrics at GET /metrics on the HTTP transport. Has no effect on the stdio transport.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_OAUTH_ALLOWED_REDIRECTS
environmentVariables.description: Additional allowed redirect URIs for hosted-proxy client registration: comma-separated exact URIs (which must include a host) and https prefix patterns ending in /*. Loopback, claude.ai, and verified first-party clients (ChatGPT, Cursor, VS Code) are always allowed; unset means no additional clients.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_OAUTH_CIMD_ALLOWED_HOSTS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated additional client_id document hosts trusted for CIMD (bare host or host:port). Verified first-party hosts are always trusted.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_OAUTH_CREDENTIALS_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Override the default OAuth credentials store path. Default: ~/.config/mediawiki-mcp/credentials.json on Linux/macOS, %APPDATA%\mediawiki-mcp\credentials.json on Windows.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_OAUTH_NO_BROWSER
environmentVariables.description: Set to '1' to skip launching a browser during the OAuth dance and log the auth URL to stderr instead. Useful in headless environments and CI.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_OAUTH_PROXY_STORE_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Path to the hosted OAuth proxy's encrypted state file, which lets sign-ins survive restarts. Default: proxy-store.enc under the mediawiki-mcp config dir; /app/data/proxy-store.enc in the Docker image.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_PUBLIC_URL
environmentVariables.description: Override the request-derived public URL used in the protected-resource discovery doc and WWW-Authenticate header. Set this when running behind a proxy that rewrites the request Host.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_SHUTDOWN_GRACE_MS
environmentVariables.description: Maximum milliseconds to wait for in-flight /mcp calls to drain on SIGTERM/SIGINT before exiting. Capped at 600000.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_TRANSPORT
environmentVariables.description: Type of MCP server transport

environmentVariables.name: MCP_UPLOAD_MAX_BYTES
environmentVariables.description: Memory cap on the server-side fetch used by upload-file-from-url and update-file-from-url. Files larger than this are routed to the wiki's own copy-upload instead of being buffered by the server. Guards this server's memory, not the wiki's $wgMaxUploadSize.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_USER_AGENT
environmentVariables.description: Replaces the User-Agent header of every outbound request, which defaults to mediawiki-mcp-server/<version> (https://github.com/ProfessionalWiki/MediaWiki-MCP-Server). If you set it, give a name and an email or URL, e.g. 'ExampleBot/1.0 (bot@example.org)'.

environmentVariables.name: PORT
environmentVariables.description: Port used for StreamableHTTP transport

environmentVariables.name: IMAGE_GENERATION_MCP_KV_STORE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Persistent-state backend URL shared by every pvl-core subsystem that needs state. `memory://` is in-process and lost on restart; `file:///path` persists on one server; `redis://`, `dynamodb://` and `mongodb://` each need their matching extra. When unset, defaults to `file:///data/state` (the volume family Docker images mount), or to `memory://` — with a warning — on a host where that directory is not usable.

environmentVariables.name: IMAGE_GENERATION_MCP_TOOLS_ALLOW
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated explicit tool names this instance exposes; every other tool is hidden from listings and cannot be invoked. Names matching no registered tool are inert. Mutually exclusive with `tools_deny`. Takes effect through `apply_tool_visibility`.

environmentVariables.name: IMAGE_GENERATION_MCP_TOOLS_DENY
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated explicit tool names hidden from this instance (absent from listings, cannot be invoked). Names matching no registered tool are inert. Mutually exclusive with `tools_allow`. Takes effect through `apply_tool_visibility`.

environmentVariables.name: IMAGE_GENERATION_MCP_SERVER_NAME
environmentVariables.description: Rename this server instance; defaults to the project name.

environmentVariables.name: IMAGE_GENERATION_MCP_INSTRUCTIONS
environmentVariables.description: Replaces the default MCP instructions text sent to clients.

environmentVariables.name: FASTMCP_LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: Log level for FastMCP internals and app loggers (DEBUG / INFO / WARNING / ERROR / CRITICAL). The -v CLI flag overrides to DEBUG.

environmentVariables.name: FASTMCP_ENABLE_RICH_LOGGING
environmentVariables.description: Set false for plain or structured JSON log output.

environmentVariables.name: IMAGE_GENERATION_MCP_A1111_HOST
environmentVariables.description: Deprecated alias for IMAGE_GENERATION_MCP_SD_WEBUI_HOST; logs a warning when used.

environmentVariables.name: IMAGE_GENERATION_MCP_A1111_MODEL
environmentVariables.description: Deprecated alias for IMAGE_GENERATION_MCP_SD_WEBUI_MODEL; logs a warning when used.

environmentVariables.name: IMAGE_GENERATION_MCP_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: When true, write-tagged tools (image generation, transforms, uploads) are hidden from clients. Set false to enable them.

environmentVariables.name: IMAGE_GENERATION_MCP_SCRATCH_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Directory where generated images are saved. Created automatically on first use.

environmentVariables.name: IMAGE_GENERATION_MCP_OPENAI_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: OpenAI API key. Enables the OpenAI provider (gpt-image-2, gpt-image-1.5, dall-e-3) when set.

environmentVariables.name: IMAGE_GENERATION_MCP_GOOGLE_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Google API key. Enables the Gemini provider (gemini-3.1-flash-image and others) when set. Get a key at https://aistudio.google.com/apikey.

environmentVariables.name: IMAGE_GENERATION_MCP_SD_WEBUI_HOST
environmentVariables.description: SD WebUI base URL (such as http://localhost:7860). Enables the SD WebUI provider when set. Compatible with AUTOMATIC1111, Forge, reForge, and Forge-neo.

environmentVariables.name: IMAGE_GENERATION_MCP_SD_WEBUI_MODEL
environmentVariables.description: SD WebUI checkpoint name, used for model-aware preset detection (SD 1.5 / SDXL / Lightning) and checkpoint override. Unset uses the instance's current model.

environmentVariables.name: IMAGE_GENERATION_MCP_DEFAULT_PROVIDER
environmentVariables.description: Provider used when no keyword triggers auto-selection: auto, openai, gemini, sd_webui, or placeholder. auto picks the first configured provider.

environmentVariables.name: IMAGE_GENERATION_MCP_TRANSFORM_CACHE_SIZE
environmentVariables.description: Maximum number of transformed image results (resize, crop, convert) kept in memory. Set 0 to disable caching.

environmentVariables.name: IMAGE_GENERATION_MCP_PAID_PROVIDERS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated provider names that cost money; generate_image asks for confirmation (client elicitation) before using them. An empty value falls back to this default; to disable confirmation, set a value that names no provider (such as none).

environmentVariables.name: IMAGE_GENERATION_MCP_STYLES_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Directory for style preset files (Markdown with YAML front matter). Created automatically if it does not exist.

environmentVariables.name: IMAGE_GENERATION_MCP_ALLOW_LOCAL_FILE_INPUT
environmentVariables.description: Allow reading input images from local filesystem paths. Off by default: only URLs and uploads are accepted.

environmentVariables.name: IMAGE_GENERATION_MCP_MAX_INPUT_IMAGE_BYTES
environmentVariables.description: Maximum accepted input image size in bytes.

environmentVariables.name: IMAGE_GENERATION_MCP_FETCH_TIMEOUT_S
environmentVariables.description: HTTP timeout in seconds when fetching remote image URLs (fetch_image and URL inputs).

environmentVariables.name: IMAGE_GENERATION_MCP_TRANSFER_TTL_DEFAULT_S
environmentVariables.description: Link lifetime in seconds when the caller requests no explicit TTL.

environmentVariables.name: IMAGE_GENERATION_MCP_TRANSFER_TTL_MAX_S
environmentVariables.description: Ceiling in seconds a caller-requested link TTL is clamped to.

environmentVariables.name: IMAGE_GENERATION_MCP_TRANSFER_GRACE_TTL_S
environmentVariables.description: Post-success grace window in seconds: a served token's TTL shrinks to this so a stalled transfer can retry within it.

environmentVariables.name: IMAGE_GENERATION_MCP_TRANSFER_LEASE_S
environmentVariables.description: Crashed-handler reclaim window in seconds for an in-flight reservation.

environmentVariables.name: IMAGE_GENERATION_MCP_TRANSFER_MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES
environmentVariables.description: Maximum size in bytes of a single upload.

environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_KV_STORE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Persistent-state backend URL shared by every pvl-core subsystem that needs state. `memory://` is in-process and lost on restart; `file:///path` persists on one server; `redis://`, `dynamodb://` and `mongodb://` each need their matching extra. When unset, defaults to `file:///data/state` (the volume family Docker images mount), or to `memory://` (with a warning) on a host where that directory is not usable.

environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_TOOLS_ALLOW
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated explicit tool names this instance exposes; every other tool is hidden from listings and cannot be invoked. Names matching no registered tool are inert. Mutually exclusive with `tools_deny`. Takes effect through `apply_tool_visibility`.

environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_TOOLS_DENY
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated explicit tool names hidden from this instance (absent from listings, cannot be invoked). Names matching no registered tool are inert. Mutually exclusive with `tools_allow`. Takes effect through `apply_tool_visibility`.

environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_SERVER_NAME
environmentVariables.description: Rename this server instance; defaults to the project name.

environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_INSTANCE_DESCRIPTION
environmentVariables.description: Concise routing context that distinguishes this deployment's material or responsibility.

environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_INSTRUCTIONS_EXTRA
environmentVariables.description: Deployment-specific behavioral policy added to the generated MCP instructions.

environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_INSTRUCTIONS
environmentVariables.description: Legacy: replaces all generated MCP instructions (deprecated; use _INSTANCE_DESCRIPTION for routing and _INSTRUCTIONS_EXTRA for policy).

environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: Log level for every logger in the process, FastMCP's included (DEBUG / INFO / WARNING / ERROR / CRITICAL). The -v CLI flag overrides to DEBUG. The unprefixed FASTMCP_LOG_LEVEL still works for one major version and logs a deprecation warning.

environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_LOG_FORMAT
environmentVariables.description: Log rendering. rich is one colour event key=value line per record, for a terminal; json is one JSON object per record, for a collector. Unset picks rich when stderr is a terminal and json everywhere else, so a container or journald gets JSON with no configuration.

environmentVariables.name: OLLAMA_HOST
environmentVariables.description: Ollama server URL for the ollama embedding provider. Bare (not MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_-prefixed), matching the Ollama ecosystem convention.

environmentVariables.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: OpenAI API key for the openai embedding provider, and the fallback key for the summarize tool when MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_SUMMARIZE_OPENAI_API_KEY is unset. Bare (not MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_-prefixed), matching the OpenAI ecosystem convention.

environmentVariables.name: VOYAGE_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Voyage AI API key for the voyage embedding provider. Bare (not MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_-prefixed), matching the OPENAI_API_KEY / OLLAMA_HOST convention. Setting it never auto-selects the provider; choose it explicitly with MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_EMBEDDING_PROVIDER=voyage.

environmentVariables.name: OPENAI_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Bare fallback for MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_OPENAI_BASE_URL (embeddings). For the summarize tool it only routes traffic when an API key already enables the feature; it never enables summarize by itself.

environmentVariables.name: OPENAI_EMBEDDING_MODEL
environmentVariables.description: Bare fallback for MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_OPENAI_EMBEDDING_MODEL.

environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_BUILD_TIMEOUT_S
environmentVariables.description: Maximum seconds an index-backed tool or resource waits for the FTS index to become queryable during a cold-start background build before raising IndexUnavailableError(reason="timeout"). Increase for large vaults.

environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_DRAIN_TIMEOUT_S
environmentVariables.description: Maximum seconds an index-querying read tool waits for the IndexWriter to drain when called with wait_for_pending_writes=true. On timeout the tool answers from the current index and reports index_stale=true in the response _meta.

environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_SOURCE_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Path to the markdown vault directory. When it does not exist, or the server cannot access it, the server starts but every tool fails with a message saying which until it is fixed (managed git mode clones into it). Symbolic links inside the vault are followed on Python 3.13+.

environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to hide the write tools (write, edit, append, delete, rename, move_folder, fetch, git_sync, the okf_* tools, create_upload_link) and serve a search-only vault.

environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_WRITE_PROTECT_EXISTING
environmentVariables.description: Refuse a write that would overwrite an existing file when no if_match etag is supplied. Deliberate replacement still works: read the file first, then pass if_match. Unaffected: edit, append, delete, rename. Set to false to allow blind overwrites.

environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_REPORT_UNRESOLVED_LINKS
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to have write, edit and append list, under unresolved_links, the target of each link the call added that get_broken_links reports. Links the note already held are left out. Off by default, leaving those responses unchanged.

environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_DISABLE_APPS_UI
environmentVariables.description: Hide the MCP Apps UI tools (browse_vault, show_context) from the tool listing for clients that do not render MCP Apps panels.

environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_INDEX_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Path to the SQLite FTS5 index file; unset keeps the index in memory. Set it for persistence across restarts.

environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_STATE_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Path to the change-tracking state file. Defaults to INDEX_PATH plus .state.json (index.db.state.json beside index.db); without INDEX_PATH the state is kept in memory. Never written into the vault by default.

environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_EMBEDDINGS_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Base path for the embeddings files. Defaults beside INDEX_PATH (index-db-embeddings.npy and .json beside index.db); without INDEX_PATH the vectors are kept in memory and rebuilt at each start. Setting it also lets the provider be auto-detected.

environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_INDEXED_FIELDS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated frontmatter fields promoted to the tag index for structured filtering. Changing it cold-rebuilds the index once on next startup; SEARCHABLE_FIELDS inherits this value when unset.

environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_REQUIRED_FIELDS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated frontmatter fields required on every document; documents missing any are excluded from the index.

environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_EXCLUDE
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated glob patterns excluded from scanning, e.g. .obsidian/**,.trash/**.

environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_TITLE_FIELD
environmentVariables.description: Frontmatter field used as the document title (falls back to title, the first H1, then the filename). Changing it cold-rebuilds the index once on next startup.

environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_SEARCHABLE_FIELDS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated frontmatter fields whose text values become keyword-searchable and enrich first-chunk embeddings. Inherits INDEXED_FIELDS when unset; the sentinel none means filterable but not searchable. Changing it cold-rebuilds the index and re-embeds once on next startup.

environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_TEMPLATES_FOLDER
environmentVariables.description: Relative folder where note templates live (used by the create_from_template prompt).

environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_PROMPTS_FOLDER
environmentVariables.description: Directory of .md prompt files that extend or override built-in prompts; a relative path is resolved against SOURCE_DIR.

environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_CONVENTIONS_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Filename of the per-folder conventions files surfaced to clients at write time (bare .md filename without glob characters). Set to none to disable folder conventions.

environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_OKF_MODE
environmentVariables.description: OKF (Open Knowledge Format) read semantics. With auto (the default), read annotations switch on when the vault declares an OKF version in its root index.md. Use off to disable OKF semantics entirely, or on to force them for an undeclared vault. Annotations are read-only; write behavior is never affected.

environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_OKF_WRITE
environmentVariables.description: OKF (Open Knowledge Format) enforced write layer. When true on an OKF-active vault, the server stamps generated provenance on each write and clears any verified attestation when a note's content changes. It also keeps each written folder's log.md and index.md current, and exposes the okf_verify tool. Requires OKF_MODE to be auto or on (a true value with OKF_MODE=off is a config error). Off by default.

environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_OKF_VERIFY
environmentVariables.description: How the okf_verify tool attributes a human review. This applies only when OKF_WRITE is on, which gates the tool. With elicit (the default), okf_verify asks the human to confirm the review through an MCP elicitation, then records the attestation only on an affirmative reply. It fails closed when the client cannot elicit or the human declines, so a model holding the human's token cannot self-attest. Set trust-auth instead to attribute to a token's sub claim with no confirmation; it rejects static bearer credentials and other client-ID-only identities. This is safe only when the sole caller is a human-driven UI. Set off to hide the tool, leaving attestation to external tooling. A non-default value with OKF_WRITE off is a config error.

environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_ATTACHMENT_EXTENSIONS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated allowed attachment extensions (e.g. pdf,png,jpg); case and a leading dot are ignored, so PDF and .pdf name the same type. Use * to allow every non-markdown file. Unset selects the built-in allowlist. A link whose target has a listed extension is not part of the link graph; changing the list rebuilds the index once.

environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_MAX_ATTACHMENT_SIZE_MB
environmentVariables.description: Maximum attachment size in MB returned by read / accepted by write; 0 disables the limit.

environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_MAX_NOTE_READ_BYTES
environmentVariables.description: Maximum bytes returned by a full-document read of a note; use `read(path, section=…)` for partial reads. 0 disables the limit.

environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_DEFAULT_SEARCH_MODE
environmentVariables.description: Mode used when a search call omits 'mode': auto, keyword, semantic, or hybrid. The default 'auto' picks hybrid when embeddings are configured and keyword when they are not. Pin 'keyword' to keep unqualified searches off the embedding provider (each hybrid or semantic search embeds the query, which costs an API call on a metered provider). A configured semantic/hybrid default also degrades to keyword without embeddings, so no setting can make a vault unsearchable; an explicit mode= argument is never downgraded.

environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_CHUNKS_PER_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Maximum chunks returned per document in search results.

environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_SNIPPET_WORDS
environmentVariables.description: Width of the snippet window (words) in search results; 0 returns full chunk content.

environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_LENGTH_DOWNWEIGHT_ALPHA
environmentVariables.description: Down-weights longer chunks in ranking: score / (1 + alpha * log(chunk_count)).

environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_MAX_CHUNK_WORDS
environmentVariables.description: Word cap per chunk; the adaptive chunker splits at deeper heading levels, then paragraph/word boundaries, to respect it. Match it to the embedding model's context. A reindex applies a new value.

environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_MAX_CHUNK_CHARS
environmentVariables.description: Character cap enforced alongside MAX_CHUNK_WORDS to bound token-dense chunks. Unset derives min(1500, model context * 2.8). Set a positive value for an exact cap, or -1 to scale with the model's full context (can exhaust memory on long-context models). A reindex applies a new value.

environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_CHUNK_OVERLAP_WORDS
environmentVariables.description: Words of overlap between adjacent budget-split fragments of the same heading section (0 disables). A reindex applies a new value.

environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_FOLDER_WEIGHTS
environmentVariables.description: Folder-prefix score multipliers (`prefix:weight` pairs, comma-separated, weights > 0) applied to all search modes; the deepest matching prefix wins (sessions:0.5 demotes sessions/**).

environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_FTS_WEIGHTS
environmentVariables.description: Per-column BM25 weights (`column:weight` pairs, comma-separated, weights >= 0) for keyword ranking. Columns: path, title, folder, heading, content, summary.

environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_EMBEDDING_PROVIDER
environmentVariables.description: Embedding provider: openai, voyage, ollama, or fastembed; setting it turns on search by meaning. Unset auto-detects from the environment (never voyage), but only when EMBEDDINGS_PATH is set. Any OpenAI-compatible endpoint works with openai plus OPENAI_BASE_URL; see the embeddings guide.

environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_OLLAMA_MODEL
environmentVariables.description: Ollama embedding model name.

environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_OLLAMA_CPU_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Force Ollama to embed on CPU only.

environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_VOYAGE_MODEL
environmentVariables.description: Voyage AI embedding model name.

environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_OPENAI_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: OpenAI-compatible API base URL for embeddings; the bare OPENAI_BASE_URL is honoured as a fallback.

environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_OPENAI_EMBEDDING_MODEL
environmentVariables.description: OpenAI-compatible embedding model name; the bare OPENAI_EMBEDDING_MODEL is honoured as a fallback.

environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_FASTEMBED_MODEL
environmentVariables.description: FastEmbed model name.

environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_FASTEMBED_CACHE_DIR
environmentVariables.description: FastEmbed model cache directory (in Docker, stored under /data/state/fastembed).

environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_EMBED_CONTEXT
environmentVariables.description: Enrich embedding input with the note title, chunk heading, and (first chunk) searchable-field values. Flipping it re-embeds the whole vault once on next startup.

environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_EMBED_TIMEOUT_S
environmentVariables.description: Per-request wall-clock budget in seconds for a single embedding HTTP call (OpenAI/Ollama). The local FastEmbed backend runs in-process with no network call and ignores this. CPU-only or large-model workloads may need 60-120 s; raise this if batches time out.

environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_EMBEDDING_BATCH_SIZE
environmentVariables.description: Number of chunks sent per embedding request. Smaller batches shorten each request (useful under a tight timeout on slow models) at the cost of more round-trips.

environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_GIT_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Token/password for HTTPS git auth; remotes must be HTTPS when set.

environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_GIT_REPO_URL
environmentVariables.description: HTTPS remote URL for managed git mode: the server clones into an empty SOURCE_DIR on startup (or validates an existing origin) and enables the pull loop, auto-commit, and deferred push.

environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_GIT_USERNAME
environmentVariables.description: Username for HTTPS git auth prompts (x-access-token for GitHub, oauth2 for GitLab, the account name for Bitbucket).

environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_GIT_PULL_INTERVAL_S
environmentVariables.description: Seconds between git fetch + fast-forward update attempts; 0 disables periodic pull.

environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_GIT_PUSH_DELAY_S
environmentVariables.description: Seconds of write-idle time before pushing; 0 pushes only on shutdown.

environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_GIT_COMMIT_NAME
environmentVariables.description: Git committer name for auto-commits, and the author name too unless an OIDC claim supplies one; set this in Docker where git config user.name is empty.

environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_GIT_COMMIT_EMAIL
environmentVariables.description: Git committer email for auto-commits, and the author email too unless an OIDC claim supplies one.

environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_GIT_COMMIT_NAME_CLAIM
environmentVariables.description: OIDC claim key used as the commit author name (e.g. name) when an OIDC token is present; the committer stays GIT_COMMIT_NAME. The claim is resolved when the tool call arrives and carried to the background commit, so it applies on every write. A configured claim the token does not carry is reported once at WARNING and the static identity is used.

environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_GIT_COMMIT_EMAIL_CLAIM
environmentVariables.description: OIDC claim key used as the commit author email (e.g. email) when an OIDC token is present; the committer stays GIT_COMMIT_EMAIL. Resolved and carried the same way as the name claim.

environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_GIT_LFS
environmentVariables.description: Run git lfs pull on startup to fetch LFS-tracked attachments; set to false for repos without LFS.

environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_FILE_WATCHER
environmentVariables.description: Watch the vault for external filesystem changes; auto-disabled when git pull is active or a webhook can deliver (HTTP/SSE transports only). Requires the file-watcher extra.

environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_FILE_WATCHER_DEBOUNCE_S
environmentVariables.description: Seconds of quiet after the last filesystem event before reindexing.

environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_FILE_WATCHER_ROOT_FLOOR
environmentVariables.description: Keep the non-recursive watch on the vault root; set false to register zero source-dir-rooted FSEvents streams (avoids repeated macOS access prompts on a home-rooted vault) at the cost of root-level files relying on scans.

environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_BOOT_REINDEX
environmentVariables.description: Reconcile offline changes at startup by reindexing once the initial build completes. Set false on a large vault to start without paying a full filesystem scan per server start; changes made while no server was running are then invisible until a reindex runs (the reindex tool, or 'markdown-vault-mcp reindex'). Note that `index_stale` reports writer idleness, not agreement with disk, so it reads false while the index may still differ from the vault.

environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_GITHUB_WEBHOOK_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Shared secret for the GitHub push-event webhook; when set, mounts POST /github-webhook on HTTP/SSE transports to trigger an immediate pull + reindex on push events.

environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_GITLAB_WEBHOOK_SIGNING_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Signing token for the GitLab push-event webhook (GitLab 19.0+); when set, mounts POST /gitlab-webhook on HTTP/SSE transports to trigger an immediate pull + reindex on push events. GitLab generates this value; copy the `whsec_` token it shows under Generate signing token rather than inventing one. Deliveries are authenticated by HMAC-SHA256 over the webhook id, timestamp and body, and a delivery older than 5 minutes is rejected.

environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_GITLAB_WEBHOOK_SECRET_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Secret token for the GitLab push-event webhook, GitLab's plain-text form and the only one below 19.0; also mounts POST /gitlab-webhook. It proves nothing about the body and cannot expire, so prefer the signing token where the GitLab version offers it. Setting both accepts either, which is how an existing webhook migrates.

environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_SUMMARIZE_PROVIDER
environmentVariables.description: Summarization backend (only openai is recognised). Unset auto-detects: the backend activates when credentials or an explicit endpoint are present.

environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_SUMMARIZE_OPENAI_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API key for the OpenAI-compatible summarize endpoint; the bare OPENAI_API_KEY is honoured as a fallback. Unset works for keyless local endpoints (Ollama).

environmentVariables.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_SUMMARIZE_OPENAI_BASE_URL
