servers.name: io.github.quackai-org/q402-mcp
servers.description: Q402 - gasless payments, yield, escrow, bridge & NAV triggers on 12 EVM chains. Sandbox-default.

environmentVariables.name: Q402_TRIAL_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Recommended path: skip this UI and run `q402_doctor` after install - it stores secrets in ~/.q402/mcp.env, which the server auto-loads. Fill this field directly ONLY if your MCP client manages secrets for you. Value is a Free Trial API key from https://q402.quackai.ai/event - BNB Chain (permanent) + Base (permanent) + Mantle limited-time (2026-08-21~08-28 UTC+9), 500 sponsored TXs, gas covered by Q402. Avalanche trial has ended. BNB and Base payments auto-route to this key when set (same rule for q402_pay and q402_batch_pay up to 5 recipients).

environmentVariables.name: Q402_MULTICHAIN_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Recommended path: skip this UI and run `q402_doctor` after install - it stores secrets in ~/.q402/mcp.env, which the server auto-loads. Fill this field directly ONLY if your MCP client manages secrets for you. Value is a Paid Multichain API key from https://q402.quackai.ai/payment - full 12-chain support with per-chain Gas Tank. Auto-routed for non-BNB payments and whenever keyScope='multichain' is chosen.

environmentVariables.name: Q402_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Mode A - real EOA signing. Hex-encoded EVM private key (0x + 64 hex chars) of YOUR MetaMask wallet, used to sign payment authorizations LOCALLY on your machine. After your first payment that wallet shows as 'Smart account' in MetaMask (EIP-7702 delegation, reversible via q402_clear_delegation). Use a fresh wallet, not your main one. Skip this and pick Mode B (Q402_AGENTIC_PRIVATE_KEY) or Mode C (server-managed Agent Wallet) if you'd rather keep your MetaMask untouched. Recommended path: run q402_doctor after install - it stores secrets in ~/.q402/mcp.env, which the server auto-loads.

environmentVariables.name: Q402_AGENTIC_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Mode B - local Agent Wallet signing. Hex-encoded EVM private key (0x + 64 hex chars) exported from your Agent Wallet at https://q402.quackai.ai/dashboard -> Agent tab -> Export. Signs LOCALLY just like Mode A, but the signer is your dedicated Agent Wallet - your MetaMask EOA is never touched. Pick this for AI-agent automation when you want a dedicated purse with per-tx + daily caps you set on the dashboard.

environmentVariables.name: Q402_ENABLE_REAL_PAYMENTS
environmentVariables.description: Live-mode switch. 0 = sandbox (test mode, no funds move - every q402_pay returns a fake hash). 1 = real on-chain payments. Default 1 since v0.5.11: safe because mode only flips to live when a live API key (q402_live_*) is set AND one of (a) a valid 32-byte private key for local signing modes, OR (b) walletMode="agentic-server" with Q402_MULTICHAIN_API_KEY for the server-managed Agent Wallet path. Without either combination, the server stays in sandbox regardless of this flag.

environmentVariables.name: Q402_MAX_AMOUNT_PER_CALL
environmentVariables.description: Per-call USD-equivalent cap for USDC/USDT/RLUSD. Any such q402_pay request with amount above this is rejected before signing. Q (QuackAI) is exempt by design (your own token; recipient allowlist + confirmation still apply). Lower this for a tighter agent blast-radius; raise for treasury-grade transfers.

environmentVariables.name: Q402_ALLOWED_RECIPIENTS
environmentVariables.description: Optional comma-separated lowercase EVM addresses. When set, q402_pay rejects any recipient not on this allowlist.

environmentVariables.name: Q402_RELAY_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Override for the Q402 relay endpoint. Defaults to https://q402.quackai.ai/api. Set explicitly when running against a self-hosted Q402 deployment or a non-canonical environment.

environmentVariables.name: Q402_AGENT_WALLET_ADDRESS
environmentVariables.description: Server-managed Agent Wallet picker (walletMode='agentic-server' only). Lowercased agent wallet address (the hex 0x... shown on the Agent tab of your dashboard) selecting which of your Agent Wallets to spend from when you hold more than one (max 10 per owner). Omit to use the default wallet. Ignored for the local-signing modes that carry their own private key.

environmentVariables.name: Q402_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: DEPRECATED legacy single-key env from pre-v0.5.0 installs. The server still reads it as a silent fallback so existing setups keep working, but new users should pick a scoped variant instead. Q402_TRIAL_API_KEY (Free Trial, BNB Chain + Base) and Q402_MULTICHAIN_API_KEY (full 12-chain surface) are designed to coexist - BNB and Base payments auto-route to the trial key, other chains use multichain. Only set Q402_API_KEY if you are migrating an existing pre-v0.5.0 install; do NOT set it alongside the scoped variants on a fresh install.

environmentVariables.name: Q402_WALLET_ID
environmentVariables.description: DEPRECATED soft-migration alias for Q402_AGENT_WALLET_ADDRESS (one release of overlap from v0.6.0). The server still accepts it but logs a deprecation notice. New installs should set Q402_AGENT_WALLET_ADDRESS directly.

environmentVariables.name: Q402_BUILDER_CODE
environmentVariables.description: Optional Base Builder Code for onchain attribution (ERC-8021 / Base Builder Codes). When set, every q402_x402_fetch payment includes your code as the client/intermediary in the x402 payment extension so payments are attributed onchain. Format: 1-32 lowercase letters, numbers, or underscores. Leave unset to disable attribution.

servers.description: Free-to-start portable memory for AI agents: encrypted, shareable, provably erased. Join SAIHM.

environmentVariables.name: SAIHM_ENDPOINT_URL
environmentVariables.description: SAIHM operator endpoint. Optional: defaults to the hosted service at https://saihm.net/mcp.

environmentVariables.name: SAIHM_SELF_JOIN
environmentVariables.description: Self-join is ON by default: the saihm_join tool creates a non-custodial identity on this device and starts activating its free memory, which needs one browser sign-in; no master secret is needed. Set to '0' to suppress the tool.

environmentVariables.name: SAIHM_MASTER_SECRET_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Path to a mode-600 file holding a 64+ hex-char master secret. Only needed if you opt out of self-join, are restoring an existing identity, or saved the key that saihm.net/free gives you. Never transmitted.

environmentVariables.name: SAIHM_IDENTITY
environmentVariables.description: An identity token written by export-identity: brings an existing SAIHM identity to this machine or a hosted agent environment without copying a key file. Set together with SAIHM_IDENTITY_PASSPHRASE; leave both unset to use this machine's own identity.

environmentVariables.name: SAIHM_IDENTITY_PASSPHRASE
environmentVariables.description: The passphrase export-identity generated for SAIHM_IDENTITY. The two together are the identity: store it as a secret.

environmentVariables.name: SAIHM_TIER
environmentVariables.description: The plan this identity onboards with (FREE, PRO, PRO_FAST, ENTERPRISE, ENTERPRISE_FAST). Defaults to FREE while self-join is on (the default); set it for a paid plan, and with SAIHM_SELF_JOIN=0 for every plan, FREE included. An export-identity token carries its own, which a non-empty value here overrides.

environmentVariables.name: SAIHM_PAYMENT_METHOD
environmentVariables.description: The payment rail of a paid plan, e.g. stripe. Required for a paid SAIHM_TIER unless an export-identity token carries it.

environmentVariables.name: SAIHM_EPHEMERAL_HOME
environmentVariables.description: Set it (e.g. 1) where the home directory is discarded at session end: the join then refuses to create a key. 0 declares the home kept and overrides the host's own signal. Unset: detected where the host says so.

environmentVariables.name: SAIHM_HOME
environmentVariables.description: Base dir for the self-join identity file ($SAIHM_HOME/free-identity.key, mode 600). Defaults to ~/.saihm. Give a full path: a relative one (a JSON config does not expand ~) is refused at start. Also the fallback state directory when SAIHM_STATE_DIR is unset.

environmentVariables.description: Base directory for document storage (defaults to current working directory). Ignored when BASE_DIRS is set.

environmentVariables.description: JSON array of base directories (e.g. '["/a","/b"]'). Takes precedence over BASE_DIR.

environmentVariables.description: JSON array of glob patterns for files to keep out of the index, each matched against the file's path relative to its root (e.g. '["plugs/**","**/*.draft.md"]').

environmentVariables.name: DB_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Path to LanceDB database directory (defaults to ./lancedb/)

environmentVariables.description: Directory where Transformers.js models are cached (defaults to ./models/)

environmentVariables.name: HF_ENDPOINT
environmentVariables.description: Hugging Face model download endpoint. Set this to a mirror URL when direct downloads are blocked (defaults to https://huggingface.co).

environmentVariables.name: MODEL_NAME
environmentVariables.description: Embedding model name (defaults to Xenova/all-MiniLM-L6-v2)

environmentVariables.name: MAX_FILE_SIZE
environmentVariables.description: Maximum file size in bytes (defaults to 104857600 / 100MB)

environmentVariables.name: RAG_MAX_DISTANCE
environmentVariables.description: Maximum distance threshold for filtering search results. Results with distance greater than this value will be excluded. Lower values mean stricter filtering (e.g., 0.5 for high relevance only)

environmentVariables.name: RAG_GROUPING
environmentVariables.description: Grouping mode for quality filtering. 'similar' returns only the most similar group (stops at first distance jump). 'related' includes related groups (stops at second distance jump). Unset means no grouping filter

environmentVariables.name: RAG_MAX_FILES
environmentVariables.description: Maximum number of files to keep in search results. Results are filtered to include only chunks from the top N best-scoring files. For example, 1 returns only the single best-matching file's chunks. Unset means no file filtering.

environmentVariables.name: CHUNK_MIN_LENGTH
environmentVariables.description: Minimum chunk length in characters (1-10000, defaults to 50). Chunks shorter than this threshold are filtered out during ingestion.

environmentVariables.name: STORE_IMAGES
environmentVariables.description: Store supported PDF and DOCX images during ingestion and return them with matched chunks (defaults to false).

environmentVariables.name: EMBED_TITLE_PREFIX
environmentVariables.description: Embed each chunk together with its document title, which can help when passages don't restate the topic the title names (defaults to false). After changing it, use a new DB_PATH or delete the index and re-ingest.

environmentVariables.name: EMBED_HEADING_PREFIX
environmentVariables.description: Add section headings to chunk embeddings when they fit (defaults to false). Independent of EMBED_TITLE_PREFIX. Re-ingest documents after changing it.

environmentVariables.name: RAG_DEVICE
environmentVariables.description: Execution device for the embedder (defaults to cpu). Passed straight to ONNX Runtime; see the Transformers.js device source for the supported backend names. If the requested device fails to initialize, the server throws an error.

environmentVariables.name: RAG_DTYPE
environmentVariables.description: Embedding quantization dtype for the embedder (defaults to fp32). Opt-in and pass-through; accepts any dtype the chosen model provides (fp32, fp16, q8, int8, ...). If the model has no variant for the requested dtype, the server throws an error. Changing this changes the embedding space — re-ingest existing data.

environmentVariables.name: RAG_HYBRID_WEIGHT
environmentVariables.description: Keyword boost factor for hybrid search (0.0-1.0, defaults to 0.6). 0 means semantic similarity only; higher values increase the keyword-match contribution to the final score.

environmentVariables.name: RAG_RERANK_CMD
environmentVariables.description: External reranker command template. Use {query} and {top} for query text and result count; unset disables reranking.

environmentVariables.name: RAG_RERANK_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: Time budget per rerank call in milliseconds (100-600000, defaults to 10000). On timeout the spawned command is killed and the pre-rerank ordering is returned.

servers.description: Matches news to Polymarket markets and returns the market's probability. Optional capped trading.

environmentVariables.name: POLYMARKET_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Your own Polygon EOA private key. Enables the trading tools (place_order, sell_order, cancel_order, get_open_orders, get_positions). Omit to run signal-only, which needs no key and no wallet.

environmentVariables.name: ACTUALLY_MAX_ORDER_USD
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Per-order USD cap for the trading tools (default 100). Enforced server-side against the market's own price, so a caller cannot understate an order to slip past it.

environmentVariables.name: ACTUALLY_DAILY_LIMIT_USD
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Rolling UTC-day USD cap shared by place_order and sell_order (default 500). Held in a persisted ledger, so it survives restarts.

environmentVariables.name: ACTUALLY_ENABLE_REDEEM
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Set to exactly 'true' to additionally register redeem_position. A second opt-in beyond the private key, because it submits a real on-chain transaction through Polymarket's relayer and is still in testing.

environmentVariables.name: ACTUALLY_SEARCH_FALLBACK
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Set to exactly 'true' to let check_news fall back to Polymarket's own market search when nothing in the cached set matches. Off by default: the query is built from the caller's text and leaves the machine.

environmentVariables.name: ACTUALLY_SPEND_STATE_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Where the spend ledger is stored (default ~/.actually-mcp-server/spend-guard.json).

environmentVariables.name: ACTUALLY_WORKER_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Only if you run your own Cloudflare Worker instead of the shared default.

environmentVariables.name: ACTUALLY_WORKER_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Shared secret for your own Worker. Not a private credential: the default one ships inside every client by design.

environmentVariables.name: ARC_NETWORK
environmentVariables.description: Which chain this instance serves: "arc-testnet" (default), "base-mainnet", "base-sepolia" or "arc-mainnet". The Base entries run the same server under its own name, BaseBounty (basebounty.app), with every address baked in. "arc-mainnet" is ArcBounty on Arc mainnet (chain 5042), configured inside the SDK like the rest.

environmentVariables.name: BOUNTY_ADAPTER_ADDRESS
environmentVariables.description: Optional BountyAdapter override, testnets only. Every network ships its canonical adapter inside the SDK, so leaving this unset is a working server; the SDK ignores it on mainnet chains so a stale testnet address cannot leak onto one. Addresses: contracts/DEPLOYMENTS.md in the repo.

environmentVariables.description: RPC URL override for the resolved network, whichever it is. Defaults to that network public endpoint if unset.

environmentVariables.name: AGENT_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Raw private key of the agent wallet. Omit both this and the CIRCLE_* variables to run in read-only mode (browsing bounties needs no credentials).

environmentVariables.name: CIRCLE_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Circle Developer-Controlled Wallet API key - alternative to AGENT_PRIVATE_KEY, no raw key in this process.

environmentVariables.name: ENTITY_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Circle Developer-Controlled Wallet entity secret.

environmentVariables.description: Circle Developer-Controlled Wallet ID.

environmentVariables.name: CIRCLE_WALLET_ADDRESS
environmentVariables.description: Circle Developer-Controlled Wallet address.

environmentVariables.name: ARCBOUNTY_MAX_REWARD_USDC

environmentVariables.name: ARCBOUNTY_MAX_SPEND_USDC
environmentVariables.description: Optional, default 50. The most post_bounty posts in total during one run of the server, in USDC.

servers.name: io.github.sweir1/obsidian-brain
servers.title: Obsidian Brain
servers.description: Obsidian MCP server: semantic search, knowledge graph, and vault editing. No plugin required.

environmentVariables.name: VAULT_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Absolute path to your Obsidian vault (or any folder of .md files).

environmentVariables.name: DATA_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Where to store the SQLite index + embedding cache. Defaults to $XDG_DATA_HOME/obsidian-brain or ~/.local/share/obsidian-brain.

environmentVariables.name: EMBEDDING_PRESET
environmentVariables.description: Preset name: english (default, bge-small-en-v1.5), english-fast, english-quality, multilingual, multilingual-quality, multilingual-ollama. Ignored when EMBEDDING_MODEL is set.

environmentVariables.name: EMBEDDING_MODEL
environmentVariables.description: Power-user override: any transformers.js checkpoint or Ollama model id. Takes precedence over EMBEDDING_PRESET. Switching auto-reindexes.

environmentVariables.name: EMBEDDING_PROVIDER
environmentVariables.description: Embedding backend. 'transformers' (local, default) or 'ollama' (requires a running Ollama server).

environmentVariables.name: OLLAMA_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of a local Ollama server. Only used when EMBEDDING_PROVIDER=ollama.

environmentVariables.name: OLLAMA_EMBEDDING_DIM
environmentVariables.description: Override the embedding dimensionality when EMBEDDING_PROVIDER=ollama. If unset, the server probes the model on startup.

environmentVariables.name: OLLAMA_NUM_CTX
environmentVariables.description: Override Ollama's num_ctx for embed requests. Leave UNSET to let obsidian-brain auto-detect via `/api/show`'s `context_length` (e.g. nomic-embed-text=2048, bge-m3=8192, qwen3-embedding:0.6b=32 768). Setting this manually imposes a hard cap and may silently truncate longer inputs — see https://github.com/ollama/ollama/issues/14259. Ollama's own default is 2048 which truncates for any model trained on a larger context. See also https://github.com/ollama/ollama/issues/7008. Fallback when both env is unset AND /api/show is unreachable: 8192.

environmentVariables.name: OBSIDIAN_BRAIN_OLLAMA_AUTO_PULL
environmentVariables.description: Auto-pull the configured Ollama model when /api/show returns 404 (model not present). Default ON — choosing an Ollama-backed preset is implicit consent to download its model. Streams /api/pull progress to stderr. Set to '0' to disable auto-pull entirely (master kill-switch) and fall back to the actionable error path (`HTTP 404 — try: ollama pull <model>`).

environmentVariables.name: OBSIDIAN_BRAIN_OLLAMA_BYOM_AUTO_PULL
environmentVariables.description: Opt-in to auto-pull for BYOM (custom EMBEDDING_MODEL) Ollama models OUTSIDE Ollama's official `library/` namespace. Default OFF — third-party models (e.g. `user/custom-fork`, `myregistry.com/team/model`) require this env var to be set to `1` before they will auto-pull, to prevent silent downloads of arbitrary user-named artifacts. Preset-known models (via EMBEDDING_PRESET) and bare model ids in the official library (e.g. `qwen3-embedding:0.6b`, `library/llama3:8b`) continue to auto-pull by default per the existing OBSIDIAN_BRAIN_OLLAMA_AUTO_PULL behavior.

environmentVariables.name: OBSIDIAN_BRAIN_NO_WATCH
environmentVariables.description: Set to '1' to disable the live chokidar file watcher. Useful on SMB/NFS vaults where FSEvents/inotify don't fire reliably — fall back to running `obsidian-brain index` on a schedule (launchd/systemd).

environmentVariables.name: OBSIDIAN_BRAIN_NO_CATCHUP
environmentVariables.description: Set to '1' to skip the startup catchup reindex pass that picks up edits made while the server was down. The live file watcher still starts (via OBSIDIAN_BRAIN_NO_WATCH=1 to disable that separately), and first-time indexing on an empty DB is unaffected — this knob only governs the post-restart `enqueueBackgroundReindex` walk.

environmentVariables.name: OBSIDIAN_BRAIN_WATCH_DEBOUNCE_MS
environmentVariables.description: Per-file reindex debounce for the live watcher, in milliseconds.

environmentVariables.name: OBSIDIAN_BRAIN_COMMUNITY_DEBOUNCE_MS
environmentVariables.description: Graph-wide community-detection (Louvain) debounce for the live watcher, in milliseconds. Louvain is the only expensive op — batching it prevents per-edit CPU spikes.

environmentVariables.name: OBSIDIAN_BRAIN_TOOL_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: Per-tool-call timeout in milliseconds. Tools exceeding this return an MCP error instead of hanging.

environmentVariables.name: OBSIDIAN_BRAIN_MAX_CHUNK_TOKENS
environmentVariables.description: Override the adaptive chunk-size budget (in tokens). When set, this beats the capacity probed from the model's tokenizer or Ollama /api/show. Use for debugging or for models with stale tokenizer configs.

environmentVariables.name: OBSIDIAN_BRAIN_CONFIG_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Override the per-user config directory where obsidian-brain stores model overrides (`model-overrides.json`) and the user-fetched seed (`seed-models.json`). Default is `$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/obsidian-brain` on macOS/Linux (or `~/.config/obsidian-brain`) and `%APPDATA%/obsidian-brain` on Windows. Both files survive `npm update obsidian-brain` because they live outside the package.

environmentVariables.name: OBSIDIAN_BRAIN_DEBUG
environmentVariables.description: Set to "1" to print a verbose synchronous startup trace to stderr — every preflight, createContext, server.connect, and shutdown step is logged with a monotonic timestamp. The LAST line before any silent failure tells you exactly which step the server reached. No-op when unset (no overhead). Use to diagnose silent-crash failure modes.

environmentVariables.name: OBSIDIAN_BRAIN_LOG_FORMAT
environmentVariables.description: Set to 'ndjson' for one-JSON-object-per-line stderr output (timestamp + level + message + structured fields). Default is human-readable plain text (`obsidian-brain: <message>`). Useful for piping logs into aggregators (Datadog, Loki, Vector, journald) that index structured fields.

environmentVariables.name: SAP_SYSTEMS_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Path to a JSON file mapping destination names to system configs (url, client, authType basic/sso/sso2/oauth, credentials). Recommended; keep the file mode 0600. See systems.example.json

environmentVariables.name: SAP_SYSTEMS
environmentVariables.description: Inline JSON map of destinations (same shape as SAP_SYSTEMS_FILE). Contains credentials — prefer SAP_SYSTEMS_FILE

environmentVariables.name: SAP_DEFAULT_DESTINATION
environmentVariables.description: Destination name used when a tool call omits `destination` (alternatively mark an entry with "default": true)

environmentVariables.name: SAP_AUTH_TYPE
environmentVariables.description: Default auth type for entries that don't specify one: sso (default), sso2, basic, or oauth

environmentVariables.name: MCP_HTTP_PORT
environmentVariables.description: When set (1024-65535), serve Streamable HTTP on http://127.0.0.1:<port>/mcp with bearer-token auth instead of stdio

environmentVariables.name: MCP_HTTP_HOST
environmentVariables.description: Bind address for the HTTP transport (default 127.0.0.1). Set 0.0.0.0 only inside containers that publish the port

environmentVariables.name: MCP_HTTP_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Bearer token for the HTTP transport; auto-generated and written to ~/.abap-adt-mcp/http-token when unset

environmentVariables.name: MCP_HTTP_MAX_SESSIONS
environmentVariables.description: Maximum concurrent MCP sessions on the HTTP transport (default 16); further initialize requests get 503

environmentVariables.name: MCP_HTTP_MAX_BODY_BYTES
environmentVariables.description: Largest request body the HTTP transport accepts, in bytes (default 4194304); larger bodies are refused with HTTP 413

environmentVariables.name: MCP_HTTP_SESSION_TTL_MINUTES
environmentVariables.description: Idle minutes after which an HTTP session (and its SAP sessions/locks) is closed (default 30)

environmentVariables.name: MCP_HTTP_ALLOWED_ORIGINS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated Origin values allowed on the HTTP transport (loopback origins always allowed when bound to loopback; * allows any)

environmentVariables.name: MCP_HTTP_ALLOWED_HOSTS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated Host header values allowed (DNS-rebinding protection; loopback hosts always allowed when bound to loopback)

environmentVariables.name: MCP_EXPORT_ROOT
environmentVariables.description: When set, exportPackageSources may only write inside this directory

environmentVariables.name: MCP_AUDIT_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Path of a JSONL audit trail: one record per tool call (tool, destination, duration, outcome ok/error/denied/unavailable, policy gate, redacted argument summary)

environmentVariables.name: MCP_ADT_TRACE_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Diagnostics: path of a JSONL trace with one line per ADT request (method, URI, status, headers). Cookie, Set-Cookie, Authorization and CSRF values are reduced to name and length; no response body is kept, error lines carry the first 300 characters of the redacted error text. Off when unset.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to make every destination read-only (server-side; only read-only annotated tools plus login/logout run). Per-destination policies live in systems.json

environmentVariables.name: MCP_ALLOW_DATA_PREVIEW
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to let tableContents read table and CDS rows on every destination that does not state policy.allowDataPreview itself (reading table data is off by default)

environmentVariables.name: MCP_ALLOW_FREE_SQL
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to allow runQuery and tableContents with sqlQuery on every destination that does not state policy.allowFreeSql itself (free SQL is off by default; implies table data)

environmentVariables.name: MCP_TOOLSETS
environmentVariables.description: Toolsets to publish: comma list (core,source,objects,transports,analysis,tests,atc,data,discovery,runtime,refactoring,rap,services,git,debugger,traces) or a preset: all (default) or focused

environmentVariables.name: MCP_DISABLED_TOOLSETS
environmentVariables.description: Toolsets to hide, comma list (core cannot be disabled)

environmentVariables.name: MCP_MAX_RESPONSE_CHARS
environmentVariables.description: Character budget for a single tool response before results are paged/truncated (default 40000, minimum 5000). Raise it if your MCP host accepts larger tool outputs

environmentVariables.name: SAP_ALLOW_REENTRANCE_TICKET
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to enable the reentranceTicket tool (disabled by default: it returns a live SAP logon credential into the conversation)

environmentVariables.name: SAP_URL
environmentVariables.description: Legacy single-system mode: base URL of the SAP system, e.g. https://host:44300

environmentVariables.name: SAP_USER
environmentVariables.description: Legacy single-system mode: SAP username

environmentVariables.name: SAP_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: Legacy single-system mode: SAP password

environmentVariables.name: SAP_CLIENT
environmentVariables.description: Legacy single-system mode: SAP client number, e.g. 100

environmentVariables.name: SAP_LANGUAGE
environmentVariables.description: Legacy single-system mode: logon language, e.g. EN

environmentVariables.name: SAP_BROWSER_PATH
environmentVariables.description: SSO destinations: path to a Chromium/Chrome/Edge binary for the browser login (auto-detected when unset)

environmentVariables.name: SAP_BROWSER_PROFILE_DIR
environmentVariables.description: SSO destinations: directory of the persistent browser profile that keeps the identity-provider session (default ~/.abap-adt-mcp/sso/<host>)

environmentVariables.name: SAP_SSO2_COMMAND
environmentVariables.description: Legacy single-system sso2 mode: absolute path to the trusted local ticket provider

environmentVariables.name: SAP_SSO2_ARGS
environmentVariables.description: Legacy single-system sso2 mode: JSON array of provider arguments (never put a ticket here)

environmentVariables.name: SAP_SSO2_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: Legacy single-system sso2 mode: provider timeout in milliseconds (default 30000; range 1000-300000)

environmentVariables.name: SAP_TLS_INSECURE
environmentVariables.description: Legacy single-system mode: set to 1 to skip TLS certificate verification for that system only (sandboxes with self-signed certificates)

environmentVariables.name: SAP_OAUTH_TOKEN_URL
environmentVariables.description: Legacy single-system mode with SAP_AUTH_TYPE=oauth: OAuth2 token endpoint (client_credentials)

environmentVariables.name: SAP_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Legacy single-system mode with SAP_AUTH_TYPE=oauth: OAuth2 client id

environmentVariables.name: SAP_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Legacy single-system mode with SAP_AUTH_TYPE=oauth: OAuth2 client secret

environmentVariables.name: SAP_OAUTH_SCOPE
environmentVariables.description: Legacy single-system mode with SAP_AUTH_TYPE=oauth: optional OAuth2 scope

environmentVariables.name: MCP_PROFILE_GATE
environmentVariables.description: Platform gate for toolsets the destination does not expose (debugger, traces, abapGit, ...): enforce (default, refuse before calling SAP), warn (log only) or off

environmentVariables.name: MCP_SOURCE_CACHE_TTL_SECONDS
environmentVariables.description: Lifetime of the per-session source cache used by grepPackage, cdsViewInfo and syntaxCheckCode (default 300; 0 keeps entries until logout)

environmentVariables.name: MCP_CACHE_DIR

environmentVariables.name: MCP_API_CLASSIFICATION_FILES

environmentVariables.name: BILLBOARD_SANDBOX
environmentVariables.description: true or 1: rehearse against a simulated board with an ephemeral wallet generated at start-up. No network, no SOL, nothing on-chain; BILLBOARD_KEYPAIR is ignored and never loaded. false or 0 (default): the real board. No other value is accepted.

environmentVariables.name: BILLBOARD_SANDBOX_SCENARIO
environmentVariables.description: Which simulated board the sandbox starts from: default (a previous poster holding at 0.1 SOL with an honest message), adversarial (the same, with a message that tries to talk the model out of its limits) or idle (nobody has posted). Ignored unless BILLBOARD_SANDBOX is on.

environmentVariables.name: BILLBOARD_KEYPAIR
environmentVariables.description: Point this at the wallet your agent already uses. Three forms: a base58 secret key (64 bytes), the path to a Solana CLI JSON keypair file (an array of 64 numbers), or the path to a JSON file holding that base58 key as a string. Unset = read-only mode: reads and dry runs work, nothing can be signed.

environmentVariables.name: MAX_BID_SOL
environmentVariables.description: Largest single bid the server will sign, in SOL. Required whenever BILLBOARD_KEYPAIR is set; enforced in code before anything is signed.

environmentVariables.name: DAILY_CAP_SOL
environmentVariables.description: Total gross bids allowed per rolling 24 hours, in SOL. Defaults to MAX_BID_SOL. Refunds do not restore the allowance.

environmentVariables.name: AUTO_BID
environmentVariables.description: false (default): write tools return a proposal and only approve_proposal signs. true: write tools sign directly, still inside the limits.

environmentVariables.name: PROPOSAL_TTL_MIN
environmentVariables.description: How long a proposal stays open before it expires, in whole minutes (1-1440). Default 60. Each write tool has one open proposal at a time; proposing again supersedes the older one.

environmentVariables.name: INTENT_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Operator-written intent file, returned verbatim in every read_billboard response. A missing file is not an error.

environmentVariables.name: HISTORY_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional URL of a site-published history.json. Unset, unreachable or disagreeing with the chain = flip history derived on-chain.

environmentVariables.name: RPC_URL
environmentVariables.description: Solana JSON-RPC endpoint.

environmentVariables.name: RPC_WS_URL
environmentVariables.description: Websocket endpoint for account-change subscriptions. Defaults to RPC_URL with https replaced by wss.

environmentVariables.name: ACTIVITY_LOG_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Append-only JSONL log of every proposal, approval, refusal and transaction, each with the agent's reasoning.

environmentVariables.name: STATE_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Where the server remembers what this wallet last read, so a fresh process (a scheduled wake) still sees changes and outbids since the previous one. One working directory per agent. Ignored in the sandbox, which persists nothing.

environmentVariables.description: Optional path to a response-masking JSON configuration file.

environmentVariables.description: Optional protected server-owned JSON file containing managed masking policies.

environmentVariables.name: GITLAB_MASKING_WORKSPACE_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Directory used to resolve response-masking configuration paths.

environmentVariables.name: GITLAB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: GitLab personal access token for local stdio use. A non-empty value overrides GITLAB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN_FILE. One of this token, GITLAB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN_FILE, GITLAB_JOB_TOKEN, GITLAB_AUTH_COOKIE_PATH, or GITLAB_USE_OAUTH=true must be set. Create a token with the GitLab scopes the tools need, such as api or read_api.

environmentVariables.name: GITLAB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Path to a file that contains the personal access token. Read once at startup and trimmed. Ignored when GITLAB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN or --token is non-empty. A missing, unreadable, or empty file stops startup. Does not replace job token, OAuth, cookie, or remote authorization.

environmentVariables.name: GITLAB_JOB_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Optional GitLab CI job token to use instead of a personal access token when running inside GitLab CI.

environmentVariables.name: GITLAB_AUTH_COOKIE_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Optional path to a GitLab authentication cookie file for cookie-based authentication.

environmentVariables.name: GITLAB_USE_OAUTH
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to start with GitLab OAuth instead of a personal access token, job token, or cookie file.

environmentVariables.name: GITLAB_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: GitLab OAuth application ID. When GITLAB_USE_OAUTH=true, set this or GITLAB_OAUTH_TOKEN_SCRIPT.

environmentVariables.name: GITLAB_OAUTH_TOKEN_SCRIPT
environmentVariables.description: Command that prints an OAuth access token. When GITLAB_USE_OAUTH=true, set this or GITLAB_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID.

environmentVariables.name: GITLAB_API_URL

environmentVariables.name: GITLAB_ALLOWED_PROJECT_IDS
environmentVariables.description: Optional comma-separated list of GitLab project IDs that this server is allowed to access.

environmentVariables.name: GITLAB_PERMISSION_MODE
environmentVariables.description: Tool exposure. Allowed values are readonly, modify, and full. Unset uses full. readonly keeps read-only tools. modify blocks delete and teardown tools.

environmentVariables.name: GITLAB_TOOLSETS
environmentVariables.description: Optional comma-separated list of toolsets to enable, such as projects, issues, merge_requests, pipelines, releases, users, groups, wiki, or search.

environmentVariables.name: GITLAB_TOOLS

environmentVariables.name: NOETIVE_DISABLE_GLOBAL_NS
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to close the shared "global" namespace on this server. Every call that routes there is refused before the request is sent, and the tools stop offering it as an example. Unset leaves it available. A value that is neither a yes nor a no stops the server rather than being read as no.

environmentVariables.name: NOETIVE_EMBEDDINGS_URL
environmentVariables.description: An OpenAI-compatible /v1/embeddings endpoint you run. Set it and embeddings are computed on this machine rather than by Noetive: a publish carries the vector alongside its text, and a query's anchor phrases are replaced by vectors so they are never sent. This is not confidential publishing: message text still travels, because that is what a search returns. The endpoint must answer to the same model name as NOETIVE_MODEL and return NOETIVE_DIMENSIONS values. Plain http is accepted only for a loopback address. Inside a container 127.0.0.1 is the container itself; use host.docker.internal.

environmentVariables.name: NOETIVE_EMBEDDINGS_KEY_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Bearer token for that endpoint, when it needs one. Endpoints running on your own machine usually do not.

environmentVariables.name: URL2MD_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: The url2md deployment to call. Must be https (only a loopback address may be plain http), because this is the origin every 402 is checked against.

environmentVariables.name: URL2MD_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: How long to wait for one conversion, in milliseconds. The default covers the service's own worst case: 20 s of fetching plus 55 s of headless render. Scopes follow the key: a collection the key cannot read over REST is not reachable over MCP either. The key also selects the environment, which is why no host or prefix appears in the URL. Hosted connectors that offer a single token field and always send Authorization: Bearer <token> cannot use this scheme at all; they need a bearer token instead - an opaque fxk_ credential bound to an existing key, issued through the Management API.

headers.name: x-foxnose-prefix
headers.description: Which Flux API to expose - the delivery endpoint serving the collections connected to it. Only needed when the key can read more than one; with a single readable API it is selected automatically. Sending the wrong value returns 403, and omitting it where it is required returns 400 listing the key's own options.
